body:
When you look at the Senate map for 2022, these are the five most important pick-up opportunities for Democrats.
| Friends -

When you look at the Senate map for 2022, these are the five most important pick-up opportunities for Democrats:
* John Fetterman in Pennsylvania
* Cheri Beasley in North Carolina
* Val Demings in Florida
* Tim Ryan in Ohio
* And yours truly in Wisconsin

**We won't expand the Democratic Senate majority unless we flip these five seats.** And we all know that a 50-50 Senate is not enough to pass bold legislation on critical issues, from defending abortion rights to enacting more gun violence prevention measures.

So if you're ready to expand the Senate majority and you're looking for a way to maximize your impact in this November's midterms, look no further than these red-to-blue Senate races.

We really need your help to flip these seats, which is why I am asking you directly:

Mitch McConnell's super PAC already reserved $66 million in advertising across Pennsylvania, North Carolina and Wisconsin, and those ads will start running very soon. And that is only a fraction of the outside spending that is going to pour into our races.

The Republican Party will do and spend whatever it takes to defend these seats, and all five of these races are expected to be decided by a very slim margin of votes.

While they have money from their corporate PACs and special interest groups, we have the people. And as long as we bring together a broad coalition in Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Florida, Ohio, and Wisconsin, we are going to flip these five seats and expand the Senate majority.

It will not happen without your support. That is why I am asking one more time:

**[Can you split a $5 contribution between John Fetterman, Cheri Beasley, Val Demings, Tim Ryan, Voter Protection Project, and my campaign today? We are all counting on people like you to help flip these seats.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23105?t=12&akid=4207%2E878179%2E5R-3rR)**

Anything that we're able to accomplish in November will come down to the number of people who get involved in this election.

Thank you for splitting a contribution today between these five Senate campaigns where we have a huge opportunity to flip seats from red to blue.

All my best,

Mandela Barnes

Friend,

Democrat Tim Ryan is in a dead heat race for Ohio’s open Senate seat and
he needs our help.

You might not know this, but I was born into a blue-collar family in
Springfield, Ohio. My dad was a factory worker. My mom was a tailor. And I
got my start in music singing in the church choir.

I’ve never forgotten where I come from—I know the challenges Ohio families
are facing, because my family faced them too. That’s how I know Ohio needs
Tim Ryan in the Senate.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/19554?t=1010&amount=25&akid=5164%2E3611125%2E4CQEvI ]Republicans are spending millions and working overtime to defeat Tim.
Will you join me in supporting his campaign by making a contribution of
whatever you can to win this crucial race?

There’s a real struggle happening in our country between love and
fear—between advancing civil rights for everyone or stripping them away,

name: Jim Jordan
subject: In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?}
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jim Jordan for Congress
body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61070198:JxuwabVkN:m:1:3331421248:2F43DFC1C5AC77FF07FD9C0F987988FB:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61070198:JxuwabVkN:m:1:3331421248:2F43DFC1C5AC77FF07FD9C0F987988FB:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61070198:JxuwabVkN:m:1:3331421248:2F43DFC1C5AC77FF07FD9C0F987988FB:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

**[Can I count on you for your signature?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61070198:JxuwabVkN:m:1:3331421248:2F43DFC1C5AC77FF07FD9C0F987988FB:r)**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61070198:JxuwabVkN:m:1:3331421248:2F43DFC1C5AC77FF07FD9C0F987988FB:r)

For freedom,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61070198:JxuwabVkN:m:1:3331421248:2F43DFC1C5AC77FF07FD9C0F987988FB:r)
Jim Jordan

| | Peter, **Election Day is finally here! And polling places across the district are officially OPEN!** Head to your usual Election Day polling place to cast your ballot early in the day, or before you head to work. If you don't know where your polling place is, go here 👇 [find your polling place](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49603940/362810005/-1137551258?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTQ2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYjgyMDA2Ni1jYTIyLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_qkTEldjKs-pOJVN3RQGlyP1tHKLt6SmvyrOOAtzJuw=&emci=75a38faf-5222-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=db820066-ca22-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=17773801) **While Lafazan HQ will be buzzing with activity shortly (we're getting started**** _early_****today!), I want to make sure I take a moment to thank you for all you've done to propel our campaign across the finish line.** As a 28 year-old county legislator, I don't match the standard description of a candidate for Congress. I don't have decades of political contacts that come with being a career political insider and cronies who I can call in for favors. And I certainly didn't have the blessing of the establishment. But our campaign had a few things going for us: we weren't afraid to try new ideas. We brought in more than 250 interns to build a movement that will last. And above all, we made sure that no one worked harder to listen and respond to the people of Long Island and Queens. **But the most important thing we've had is folks like you.** So many New Yorkers know the system is broken. We all see politicians yelling past each other every day, working harder on writing sarcastic tweets than on solving problems, or looking for approval from political insiders instead of everyday people and our working families. **I'm proud of our campaign's dedication to breaking that cycle, and our commitment to deliver on the common sense solutions we all know work.** So Peter, I'm grateful that today you and the rest of our supporters across the district finally get the chance to participate in our democracy. Thanks for pulling the lever for me. More to come! _Josh_ |

body:
https://www.catherineforcongress.com [https://www.catherineforcongress.com]
Election Day! Make a Plan to Vote before 9pm
Today is the day we have been waiting for but casting your vote for Catherine isn’t the only thing you should do today...tell THREE FRIENDS TO VOTE FOR CATHERINE TODAY!
Here’s what a few of Catherine’s supporters are saying...
I think she is the best candidate among the field...She is a strong advocate for our values--gun safety, women's reproductive rights and support for Israel, NATO assistance for the Ukraine and President Biden's agenda. She also has the most legislative experience among those running. She has been in the majority and minority in the county legislature and has gotten things done in both positions. As many of you know, I have worked on a great number of issues in our community, and Catherine has been helpful in all of them. Her accomplishments as Majority Leader of the county legislature include a ban on gun shows at the County Center and questions about salary history during job searches, and creating paid sick leave days. When in the minority, she led a successful bipartisan effort to create the County Office of Energy Conservation & Sustainability. This last item is noteworthy, since the House may change leadership after this fall's election. This is a decision regarding who will best serve the needs of the district and has the best opportunity to win and that would be Catherine!!!! Go VOTE!!
Sunny (Larchmont/Mamaroneck)
We believe Catherine has the best path to victory against the incumbent Congressman Bowman in the upcoming Democratic primary. We respect that Catherine has significant experience as an elected representative; that she is detail oriented; that she listens and learns; and then works to get things done. We want a representative like Catherine in Washington who knows how to work across the aisle. Catherine has more than a dozen formal endorsements and demonstrating to us that is well regarded by colleagues.
Dianne, Sarah, Michelle, & Suzanne (Scarsdale)
When our family had nothing but each other after the Hurricane, our home destroyed by flooding,
Catherine showed up and took care of us. She recruited volunteers to help with cleanup, she found us housing, she got us connected to the local food bank. At our family’s lowest point, Catherine was there to lift us up. That’s why I’m voting for Catherine Parker for Congress.
Lily (Rye)
Now it’s your turn. Make a plan to vote TODAY!
Tuesday August 23: Election Day

body:
Fellow Conservative:
Missouri's conservative State Attorney General, Eric Schmitt (R-MO), has won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate.

And unlike the Republican leadership in the Senate, we are working harder than ever to win a conservative majority this year!
Eric Schmitt ran in a crowded field of candidates and won a come-from-behind victory in a critical battleground state that will determine control of the Senate.
Now, he faces liberal Anheuser-Busch heiress Trudy Busch Valentine (D-MO) in the November election. Valentine has a fortune to spend in this race, and you can be sure the Left's entire political machine will be working day and night to defeat Eric Schmitt.
Please support Eric Schmitt's grassroots campaign today!
Individuals can give up to $2,900 to Schmitt's general election campaign, but any amount will help, no matter how small.
The only way for him to compete financially is for us to use the strength of our numbers and bundle thousands of small-dollar donations together for him.
So please take action right now and support one of the strongest conservative Senate candidates in the nation.
Eric Schmitt is a tough, principled constitutional conservative who has fought for the rights of individuals against anti-American, anti-family elites colluding against them. During his tenure as Missouri's Attorney General, Schmitt has been everywhere.
✓ When Democrats manipulated 2020 election rules, Schmitt leaped into the fray, leading other state attorneys general to support election integrity lawsuits in Pennsylvania and Texas.
✓ When school boards tried to force students to wear masks against their parents' objections, Schmitt took them to court on behalf of kids, families, and true science.
✓ When Big Tech firms colluded to cancel conservatives from their platforms, Schmitt launched one of the nation's most extensive investigations into their discriminatory business practices.
✓ When woke activists attacked a Missouri high school football coach for leading his players in prayer before a game, Schmitt defended the coach and made clear to school officials that he did nothing wrong under the law or the Constitution.
✓ Schmitt was also the first Attorney General to sue the Chinese Community Party and the Wuhan Institute of Virology for their criminal negligence, coverups, and lies stemming from the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic.
These were all fights of choice by Eric Schmitt. He didn't have to wage them, and there were plenty of reasons not to. Big donors and the media don't like culture warriors, don't like holding leftists accountable. But Eric Schmitt doesn't work for them - he works for the
people. As Attorney General, he put Missouri families first. And in the Senate, he will put America First.
Please help send Eric Schmitt to the U.S. Senate.
The most important job for senators in 2023 won't be passing bills - not with Joe Biden in the White House for two more years. No, it will be investigations - subpoenaing documents, deposing witnesses, finding whistleblowers, and holding hearings. And we need a fighter like
Eric Schmitt to do it.
For all Biden's scandals, there's much we still don't know about:
▶︎ Hunter Biden's shady business dealings.▶︎ The border crisis and the location of illegal immigrants.▶︎ Anthony Fauci's role in the development of Covid-19.▶︎ The FBI's targeting of parents as "domestic terrorists."▶︎ White House collusion with Big
Tech on censoring conservatives.
No one will pursue the truth more doggedly than Eric Schmitt. He will join Ted Cruz, Mike Lee, Rand Paul, Ron Johnson, and others in uncovering the facts about how Joe Biden, the Democrats, and the media are trying to steal our freedom and destroy everything that made America
great.
Join SCF in supporting Schmitt in Missouri's Senate race this year. He is precisely what we need in Washington right now: a fighter, a truth-teller, and a defender of America's Constitution and culture.
Please contribute $10, $25, $50, or more to Eric Schmitt today!
SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contribution to his campaign.
Thank you for being part of our team and for doing so much to help build a conservative Senate.

Sincerely,

Matt Hoskins
Senior Advisor
Senate Conservatives Fund

name: Katie Britt
subject: I have nothing to apologize for
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc
body:
Especially when it comes to my children
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zk8ihj8se7sfj2sfb123j9de95u5ouhsf8bka640_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbojacpj6arr2s5hedqrfcjjcpoe9ob66hg68ttkeeor6o73m3g76ob3eirbccrn6v970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6ptie5j39p5lmdjrcoj665ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933cdi64pb3c1h6eoh5u)
| Friend, I’m not sorry.
I’m not sorry for being a momma on a mission and let me tell you why. I’m a mother of two young children who are packing up their new school supplies, grabbing their lunches off the kitchen table, and piling in the car to take on a new school year & all it has to offer. Every year, the night before my son and daughter start a new school year, we pray together as a family. We pray for a year full of endless opportunities, an abundance of learning, and limitless growth. Our children and grandchildren ARE the future of our great nation and we owe it to them to put Alabama first. Wait - I’m jumping ahead, Friend. Let me take a step back and introduce myself. I’m Katie Britt and I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I firmly believe it’s time to fight for the next generation and preserve the American Dream for our children. When I first announced I was running for the Senate, I heard reason after reason why I should NOT throw my hat in the ring. But I have two EVEN BIGGER reasons why I decided to block out the noise and dive headfirst into this race: Their names are Bennett and Ridgeway. My school-aged daughter and son who continually remind me “God calls us to do hard things.”
---

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zteoke4q9t880ohvf10iokeqedleb161bejlkarg_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9im6o32cth2bs)
---
| | **Let me be clear.** My children are my driving force, but this campaign is about EVERY child. From the little ones entering their first day of kindergarten to the high-school seniors day-dreaming about what the future holds - _I’m fighting for them._ _But, this campaign is also about you. _ _It’s about_** _our_** _children and grandchildren. __
__It’s about every student, parent, and family.__ _**_It’s about the future of America._** I’ll be honest with you, Friend. I never in a MILLION YEARS thought I’d be writing you an email like this, because I never thought that I, a mom of two who became a mother while still putting herself through law school, would be a candidate for the United States Senate. But then again, if anyone knows about persistence and hard work, it’s this girl.
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7ghl0a8nclklk4a7p58fa4b4065rl1im0q08nio_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9im6o32cth2bs)
---
I’m a public school grad from the Wiregrass who watched her parents work six, sometimes seven, days a week just to make ends meet. My dad, my role model, would come home, exhausted from a long day's work, and still make sure to ask me about my school day, what subjects were giving me trouble, and to help me with my math homework and book reports. _My parents gave me a front row seat to watch the American Dream in action_ , and I learned to never take a single day for granted. Beyond that, they taught me what it meant to be my unapologetic self - a devoted Christian, a fearless leader, and a proud conservative. **Let me say that one more time, Friend.** I’m a **devoted Christian** who is dedicated to supporting every child from the womb to the workforce. I’m a **fearless leader** who will stand up for every child, parent, and family. And I’m a **proud conservative** who knows education is the key to opportunity, which is at the heart of the American Dream. Providing children with access to high-quality educational options early is critical to their success later in life.
That is why I strongly believe in school choice: every single Alabama child deserves the best possible education - **regardless of their zip code.**
Friend, you and I both know the jobs of TOMORROW require quality education now, and I am dedicated to supporting Alabama’s children TODAY. **[_Our children are going to need every leg up we can give them if we want them to succeed while learning and working in a nation ruled by Radicals like Joe Biden._](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkj8k8bq38tou7gjqkkco7pn4qhp7niqaggbm1b8_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9im6o32cth2bs) ** Earlier in this email I mentioned I was a _momma on a mission_. That has been my motto since my daughter, Bennett, made me a mother. From that day forward, I lived for my daughter. And then when my son, Ridgeway, came along I lived for them both. I’ve made every single decision with them in mind, and I will continue to do that every day as a United States Senator. It’s my job as a mother to fight tooth and nail for my children. And, if elected in November, I will proudly expand on my role as a momma on a mission and fight for every American child as if they were my own. [_**If you’re able to join me in the fight for our children - and our nation - I hope you’ll consider making an immediate contribution of any amount to bolster my campaign. A donation from a fellow conservative like you will make all the difference in this battle for the next generation.**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zuocjj0g13q91ugqb9mldsru5cmq78nv46bqnt58_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9im6o32cth2bs) Thank you in advance for your support,
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgd7d2grrgachdl9kdi0977271dberllf459cdho_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9im6o32cth2bs)
---
Katie Britt Mother of Bennett & RidgewayCandidate for U.S. Senate

[__P.S. - I’ve been a staunch supporter of Alabama’s voluntary First Class Pre-K program, which has been ranked as the nation’s best for 16 consecutive years, because I know that parents know what’s best for their children. We’re just starting to send our kids back to school, and there’s no better time than RIGHT NOW to make a contribution. Without your donation, I’m afraid we won’t have the necessary resources to stand up to Biden and the Radical Left when they try to take away even more choices and opportunities from our innocent children.__](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmn4en2151o8uggi58ka9mug6ease8lcu6068h90_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9im6o32cth2bs)

But I have two EVEN BIGGER reasons why I decided to block out the noise and dive headfirst into this race: Their names are Bennett and Ridgeway. My school-aged daughter and son who continually remind me “God calls us to do hard things.” | | Let me be clear. My children are my driving force, but this campaign is about EVERY child. From the little ones entering their first day of kindergarten to the high-school seniors day-dreaming about what the future holds - I’m fighting for them. But, this campaign is also about you. It’s about our children and grandchildren. It’s about every student, parent, and family. It’s about the future of America. I’ll be honest with you, Friend. I never in a MILLION YEARS thought I’d be writing you an email like this, because I never thought that I, a mom of two who became a mother while still putting herself through law school, would be a candidate for the United States Senate. But then again, if anyone knows about persistence and hard work, it’s this girl. I’m a public school grad from the Wiregrass who watched her parents work six, sometimes seven, days a week just to make ends meet. My dad, my role model, would come home, exhausted from a long day's work, and still make sure to ask me about my school day, what subjects were giving me trouble, and to help me with my math homework and book reports. My parents gave me a front row seat to watch the American Dream in action , and I learned to never take a single day for granted. Beyond that, they taught me what it meant to be my unapologetic self - a devoted Christian, a fearless leader, and a proud conservative. Let me say that one more time, Friend. I’m a devoted Christian who is dedicated to supporting every child from the womb to the workforce. I’m a fearless leader who will stand up for every child, parent, and family. And I’m a proud conservative who knows education is the key to opportunity, which is at the heart of the American Dream. Providing children with access to high-quality educational options early is critical to their success later in life. That is why I strongly believe in school choice: every single Alabama child deserves the best possible education - regardless of their zip code. Friend, you and I both know the jobs of TOMORROW require quality education now, and I am dedicated to supporting Alabama’s children TODAY. Earlier in this email I mentioned I was a momma on a mission. That has been my motto since my daughter, Bennett, made me a mother. From that day forward, I lived for my daughter. And then when my son, Ridgeway, came along I lived for them both. I’ve made every single decision with them in mind, and I will continue to do that every day as a United States Senator. It’s my job as a mother to fight tooth and nail for my children. And, if elected in November, I will proudly expand on my role as a momma on a mission and fight for every American child as if they were my own. Thank you in advance for your support, Katie Britt Mother of Bennett & RidgewayCandidate for U.S. Senate | | Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc. | Hi Friends,
Here are five things to know about Geoff and Leah's campaigns as you head to work today:
---
---
| 1\. Pressing for Change at the MBTA
---
| Geoff and Leah are monitoring the closure of the Orange Line very carefully every day. Yesterday, Geoff spoke with commuters at Government Center to get their feedback on this situation.
---
|
---
|
---
| If you are a commuter looking for transportation alternatives during the shutdown, here is a link to the MBTA's Alert Page for updated system information (note: external link):

---
| Geoff and Leah have been talking about infrastructure needs for months, and they have been vocal in expressing their frustration with the MBTA and plans for reform for weeks. Here's a link to a statement Leah made back on August 6:
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cwKWcqU6b57i0qOseAsTKRyqQbCkKvOg-G89qR6rTT4sgxuEdhQbH9jJvqwJyVjmFiwU38A0IdId-IowYfCJNrs8iMp-uQBxFPRVjwUFrSH9M6I5LGhQvqlHOImFtHTHyLZRw-T0Pesvn4HU7p2PBw==&c=Hd_G-h193ObnN6gS4MWAL-XGozlNz0-xD4t8QlVWnOUh6T4dUmYG_w==&ch=QndaMfigCj0YcBAfY21YqCUW4Jcx7OUVwR55MI16kGDsjDdVrrdLxQ==)
---
---
| 2\. It's time to give you your money back!
---
|
---
| Yesterday the Massachusetts Fiscal Alliance, the Fiscal Alliance Foundation, and Citizens for Limited Taxation announced that they are partnering with the New England Legal Foundation and the Goldwater Institute to prepare to bring a lawsuit to enforce Chapter 62F of Massachusetts law. That's the provision of our laws, passed in 1986, that requires the state to give taxpayers money back this year. Geoff immediately expressed his full support for this partnership, if necessary to enforce Chapter 62F. As Geoff and Leah say all the time:
"It's time to give the people their money back!"
---
---
| 3\. Geoff and Leah - A Record of Winning
---
| Did you know that Geoff and Leah served together in the MA Legislature, and that they both participated in the 2014 ballot initiative to repeal automatic inflationary increases in the state gas tax? Here's a photo of them speaking at a Statehouse rally way back then!
---
---
Geoff and Leah have been winning Republican elections - as candidates and activists - for more than a decade. And, together, they're prepared to win again in November!
---
| 4\. Geoff talks about being a small business owner
---
| One of the things that motivated Geoff Diehl to run for Governor was the poor treatment of small businesses here in Massachusetts during the pandemic. Geoff and his wife own a small business themselves, so they appreciate the importance of small businesses to our economy. Helping small businesses thrive again will be an important theme of the Diehl Administration.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cwKWcqU6b57i0qOseAsTKRyqQbCkKvOg-G89qR6rTT4sgxuEdhQbH9jJvqwJyVjmDxnrQJzvbiamkY2N8s6tnijDrddBxiS__JlvZK4inN6ZIjeuvuwMeS5REeJvD6Lts0C5n9ckcFir9jShPTEm3A==&c=Hd_G-h193ObnN6gS4MWAL-XGozlNz0-xD4t8QlVWnOUh6T4dUmYG_w==&ch=QndaMfigCj0YcBAfY21YqCUW4Jcx7OUVwR55MI16kGDsjDdVrrdLxQ==)
---
---
| 5\. Early Voting is Just Days Away!
---
| The Republican Primary is on September 6 - that's just TWO WEEKS FROM TODAY! Early voting (in-person) will be conducted the week prior to the election. Here's a summary of some important upcoming dates:

REPUBLICAN PRIMARY | TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 6 * Polls will be open 7am - 8 pm
---

August 23, 2022
Dear friend,
Shelby County residents made a statement. On August 4, our community overwhelmingly chose to reelect Shelby County Mayor Lee Harris [https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/08/04/early-voting-shelby-county-mayor-lee-harris-has-lead-over-worth-morgan/10162114002/] and support candidates for our next era all the way down the ballot.
Now, Mayor Harris is ready to pursue his most ambitious agenda yet. In our next era, we are focused on our next generation. We want to tackle the changes needed to ensure clean air and water for our community, livable neighborhoods for families, and a local economy that works for working women and men.
But we need YOUR help. Shelby County residents who would like to join the Our Next Era Transition Team are encouraged to apply by visiting www.OURNEXTERA.com [http://www.ournextera.com/] for information about transition planning, other ways to volunteer, and career opportunities in Shelby County Government.
APPLY TO JOIN THE TRANSITION TEAM [http://www.ournextera.com/]
Transition team volunteers will be selected on a rolling basis between now and September 15, 2022.
Not a Shelby County resident, but know someone who shares our values and has a heart for service? Please forward this email and encourage them to check out www.OURNEXTERA.com [http://www.ournextera.com] .
Thanks again for your support.
Warm regards,
Frankie Dakin
Senior Campaign Advisor to Mayor Lee Harris

I joined the Army right out of high school and served for 27 years overseas as a soldier including a decade fighting in Iraq and Afghanistan. Service has always been a major part of my life. So when I watched the events of January 6th -- when a Confederate battle flag was paraded through the Capitol rotunda and police officers were beaten with it, I was shocked. And knowing that my representative, Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, had actually helped incite the mob that attacked our Capitol, I knew I had to act. _**The very next day, I resigned my post as a government official and decided to run against her.**_ Since then, our campaign has grown at a record pace, and we’ve out-raised Marjorie Taylor Greene for three consecutive quarters. subject: We Must Tackle Fentanyl in Colorado

body:
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-r/) Hi Peter, Colorado has reached a crisis point concerning fentanyl.**One pill can kill.** Let that sink in. Just one pill, or much less than one pill in some cases, can kill you or your children! Colorado has the second highest number of fentanyl deaths in the country. That number has skyrocketed in the last three years to more than 1,600 deaths in our state.Yesterday, Danny and I joined heartbroken families gathered at the State Capitol for Fentanyl Prevention and Awareness Day. I reconnected with a mom, Miki, who I met on the trail a few months ago. You may have heard me share the story of her beautiful daughter Hannah, who she lost to a fentanyl overdose. You see, 16-year-old Hannah took a Xanax pill a friend gave her when she was having a bad day. It was laced with fentanyl and she died. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-y/) We cannot lose any more children to fentanyl. I'm ready to tackle this crisis head on. **The first step is to end Colorado's sanctuary state status.** When Jared Polis ran for governor four years ago, he promised to veto any legislation that would make Colorado a sanctuary state. He did not do that. In fact, after making us a sanctuary state, he signed a law in 2019 making the possession of up to 4 grams of fentanyl (enough to kill thousands of people) a misdemeanor. And just this year, he showed a lack of leadership by signing another failed fentanyl law that makes it even harder for prosecutors to convict fentanyl dealers.**The second step to fighting the fentanyl crisis is to return to law and order and support our men and women in blue.** [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-j/) Over the weekend, I had the opportunity to attend a Law Enforcement Appreciation event in Pueblo West.I was raised by a reserve police officer. I will restore law and order through truth in sentencing, firing those on the parole board who will not enforce it, getting rid of personal recognizance bonds, and appointing judges who are tough on crime. And, mark my words, **I will end Colorado's sanctuary status.** **Campaign Trail:** This week, the campaign trail will take me back to Pueblo for the Colorado State Fair. We'd love to have you walk with our Heidi RV, Zeb. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-t/) I will also be speaking to the Colorado Water Congress in Steamboat this week and attending the Girl Scout Women of Distinction event in Denver. I would be remiss if I didn't share pictures from Watermelon Day at the Arkansas Valley Fair this past weekend. I had an absolute blast and got some really awesome watermelon! [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-i/) The path to victory is clear! Colorado has never been more well-suited than it is right now. Just last year, Virginia was in a similar place with a totally blue slate of elected officials. We're closing in JUST like Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin did. Check out my interview on the Dan Caplis show last week where we talk about the path to victory. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-d/) **[(Click to listen)](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-h/)** **Help us unleash Colorado's potential!** Thank you for all your support! Please get involved. If we work hard for the next 78 days, we will be rewarded in November.All my best,HeidiPS - Don't forget to check out [**ThePolisTax.com**](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-k/) EACH day and share our site with friends. [$10](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-u/) [$50](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-n/) [$100](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-p/) [Other](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-x/) [Volunteer](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qwgtk-ttjjilthht-m/) Never miss a beat, follow me on social media! name: Jon Kaiman
subject: Proven Leaders Endorse Kaiman for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Kaiman for Congress
body:
Peter-
Today, when you make your decision at the polls, I hope you are reminded of my commitment to serving the residents of the 3rd Congressional District. I have done so on the state and local level, and I will do the same as your Representative in Congress. My experience, vision, and record of results have allowed me to build a large coalition of support in this race and below are some of their testaments to my experience and their commitment to my candidacy:
_Jon Kaiman is one of the most effective governmental leaders in New York State. In this time of crisis, we need to send true leaders to Congress like Jon Kaiman, who will fight for our principles and deliver real results._
--**Steve Bellone, County Executive of Suffolk County**
_As Chair of the Police Reform Task Force, Jon brought all leaders to the table to create meaningful reform while maintaining public safety and community trust. Jon is now leading the development of the Brentwood Resource Center, a state-of-the-art facility that will create vital jobs for our community and open the doors of opportunities for our youth. Long Island needs more creative, solution-oriented leaders like Jon to represent us in Washington._
-- **Phil Ramos, Asst. Speaker of the NYS Assembly**
_Jon has a heart for our community. It was Jon 's heart that led him to work to create the award-winning Yes We Can __Community C_ _enter and attract over $100 million from private investors to build affordable housing. No other candidate has Jon 's record of accomplishment._
-- **Siela Bynoe, Nassau County Legislator**
_I 've always found [Kaiman] to be pragmatic, professional and an independent thinker. He's able to listen to different opinions. If you were to call any county legislator, they would all say Jon is engaging, able to be civil during heated moments and is able to pragmatically find a way to get projects to the finish line._
-- **Tom Donnelly, Suffolk County Legislator**
****
_Jon Kaiman answered the prayers of a generation in New Cassell by focusing resources on community revitalization, traffic mitigation, and affordable housing. Time and time again, Jon has listened to residents ' concerns and stood up for our community._
-- **Robert Troiano, Councilmember of Town of North Hempstead**
_Jon cares for the needs of our community and listens to the concerns of his neighbors. His many years of experience have prepared him to be our Congressman. He has more experience than any of the other candidates. Now it 's time we support him._
**-- Viviana Russell, Fmr. Councilmember of Town of North Hempstead**
_In Jon Kaiman, you get a true leader, who has led real change on police reform, delivered for working families, and opened government to residents in North Hempstead and later Suffolk through the introduction of a 311 system, and in Congress will fight to codify Roe v. Wade and strengthen gun safety laws including a ban on assault weapons._
**-- I. Daneek Miller, Fmr. NYC Council Member**

_Kaiman has always fought to make Long Island a better place to live and raise a family for working New Yorkers; our entire state needs a proven champion for working people in Washington._
**-- Kyle Bragg, 32BJ SEIU President**

_Kaiman is a serious-minded person more interested in getting things done, and a consensus builder who stands for our shared values and priorities, including preserving and maintaining public mass transit and a commitment to enhancing bus service, as well as the rights of employees to organize and collectively bargain._

name: Kristin Hurley - Peter Hernandez for Congress
subject: Recap from Volunteer Meeting 8/22
body:
**Hi Vote for Pedro volunteers,**
**
**
**Here is a recap of last night 's volunteer zoom meeting!**
**Thank you to those who were able to join!**

**We are forming regional canvassing groups**
\- Salinas
\- San Jose
\- Gilroy
\- Morgan Hill
\- Watsonville
\- Hollister

**We want our volunteers** in those regions connected and ready to go by this
weekend! Regional crews will be communicating by text groups or perhaps

Signal app groups if that is most convenient to everyone (case by case basis).
We would like the groups to be somewhat autonomous for arranging
canvassing hours during the evening and weekends, but Peter and I will join in
as much as we can so please help keep me apprised of your canvassing schedules.

I will arrange to get supplies (doorhangers) to one person in each regional area
by this weekend. If you'd like to be the point person in general for your region, let
me know. It would be great to have someone as the main organizer in each area.

As for where to canvas, I will work with each group to get you on the Catch the Vote

platform. We'll work by precinct, and as those get covered I can send more
precincts or neighborhoods to hit. Catch the Vote does not require an app on your
phone, you will be texted a link to open up the system. Don't stress if tech is not
your thing....I can either teach you how to use it or you can just simply be told
which streets/neighborhoods to work in and that will be great!

Look for Joe or I to be calling and getting this rolling this week!

**As for Campaign Sidekick**(the phone banking system) there were a few hiccups
this week with the platform but I think it's solved now. Please let us know if you

want more training on the system or if it's not working for you. We had a question about
what the VM message from Peter says [that the system leaves when calls are

unanswered] and I will find that out from Peter and let you know (I was not involved
when it was recorded).

**We are having a major fundraising event for Peter** on Sept 7th at the Fox Theater
downtown Salinas. Attached is the flyer graphic and pdf. Please share and encourage
people to buy a ticket or a table. We have Pastor Rob McCoy from Godspeak Calvary
Church speaking, State Senator Shannon Grove, etc. We need this to be a packed

event! Please share!

**I did not get to mentioning the upcoming event schedule last night,** but here it is:

\- Friday, Aug 26th we'll be at the Burnett overpass in Morgan Hill. The dedicated

volunteers there have held banner rallies on that overpass for two years now. Peter
and I will join them for a bit during the 2-5pm hours, but feel free to go out there
with our without us to help thank those people for doing what they do (they have
a Peter Herndandez Banner)

\- Saturday Aug 27th we'll be at the Vietnamese Community Event at the Vietnamese
American Cultural center (2072 Lucretia Ave, SJ) from 10-1pm approx. Let me know
if you'd like to join us there

\- Sunday Aug 28th is Aromas Day, we have a booth, please let me know if you can

take a turn at our booth, we have to man it from 9am-4pm. Aromas Day is a super fun
community event, tons of garage sales :)

**Let me know if you 'd like to join for any of those events.**
**We are working to keep the events page better updated at the website.
**
**
**
**Thank you!**
**Kristin**

\--

Kristin Hurley
Campaign Manager
Peter Hernandez for Congress
CA District 18
831-254-5606

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) Dear Peter, I'm not going to beat around the bush... Big Tech has become the censorship arm of the radical left. My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we 've caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That's why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties - _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r)** Let me explain... Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O'Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for "violating the government's rules about election integrity." _Hopefully, I don 't need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment. _ But it gets much worse... When Rogan tried to figure out why he was censored, he found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence him. You see, Alex Padilla was being considered to fill Kamala Harris' vacated seat in the U.S. Senate - and he was afraid that Rogan's tweets would hurt his image and chances of being appointed. **So, the office of Alex Padilla immediately instructed his press secretary to contact Twitter and shut Rogan up.** **From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department **To:** Twitter **Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post: [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) That's why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. But the only way we can take on the deep pockets and deep connections of these tyrants is with the help of patriotic Americans like you. [**Will you help us fund this critical lawsuit by sending a generous, tax-deductible contribution of just $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. Two years ago, I founded the Center for American Liberty with the purpose of protecting our First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties from being destroyed by today's left. We've taken on Governor Gavin Newsom in California when he unconstitutionally shut down small businesses, banned people from going to church, and kept millions of children locked up in their homes--out of school--during the pandemic. We've taken on Antifa for viciously assaulting and nearly killing journalist Ando Ngo who exposed Antifa's vile, anarchic plot to destroy the United States and turn it into a socialist utopia. **And now, we 're taking on Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and others for colluding to eliminate Rogan O'Handley's freedom of speech. ** But as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our civil liberties is with the generous help of like-minded conservative patriots like you. And this massive lawsuit is expected to cost us over $1,000,000. _After all, we are taking a multi-billion-dollar company, the state of California, and a handful of well-connected politicians._ [**So, can I count on you to help us stand up to Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla by making a tax-deductible contribution of $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) I'm not exaggerating when I say that this is the legal battle that will define our generation - and the future of our country. Will we sit back and allow elitist politicians, billion-dollar corporations, and faceless government agencies to continue to trample our constitutional freedoms? Or will we prove that WE, the American people, are still in control of our own lives? [**Please join us in this critical fight to defend the First Amendment by contributing $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61074451:J7u9XbVNM:m:1:3331421248:8DE9F75080D1E9EBB1279CAE2182BE41:r) Sincerely, Harmeet K. Dhillon P.S. But now that there is clear evidence that a California elected official colluded with big tech to censor conservatives who wanted to comment on the 2020 election those same leftists are dead-silent. I am absolutely fed up with left's hypocrisy, double-standards, and blatantly unconstitutional behavior. subject: Stop the IRS
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jim Jordan for Congress
body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60646023:ssMSGwhNC:m:1:2125848345:56768BB8DF72A2E4FFD4E00C8AB4B1A6:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60646023:ssMSGwhNC:m:1:2125848345:56768BB8DF72A2E4FFD4E00C8AB4B1A6:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60646023:ssMSGwhNC:m:1:2125848345:56768BB8DF72A2E4FFD4E00C8AB4B1A6:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government ... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

**[Can I count on you for your signature?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60646023:ssMSGwhNC:m:1:2125848345:56768BB8DF72A2E4FFD4E00C8AB4B1A6:r)**[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60646023:ssMSGwhNC:m:1:2125848345:56768BB8DF72A2E4FFD4E00C8AB4B1A6:r)

For freedom,

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60646023:ssMSGwhNC:m:1:2125848345:56768BB8DF72A2E4FFD4E00C8AB4B1A6:r)
Jim Jordan

name: Jim Jordan
subject: 87,000 new workers to the IRS
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jim Jordan for Congress
body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61069294:JWkmFbVNt:m:1:3334294963:52F6454ECD5502BB09ECF348D1FC51FA:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61069294:JWkmFbVNt:m:1:3334294963:52F6454ECD5502BB09ECF348D1FC51FA:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61069294:JWkmFbVNt:m:1:3334294963:52F6454ECD5502BB09ECF348D1FC51FA:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

**[Can I count on you for your signature?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61069294:JWkmFbVNt:m:1:3334294963:52F6454ECD5502BB09ECF348D1FC51FA:r)**[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61069294:JWkmFbVNt:m:1:3334294963:52F6454ECD5502BB09ECF348D1FC51FA:r)

For freedom,

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61069294:JWkmFbVNt:m:1:3334294963:52F6454ECD5502BB09ECF348D1FC51FA:r)
Jim Jordan

| | Dear friend,

Today is the big day. It is Election Day.

I am thankful for the outpouring of support my campaign has received from grassroots patriots throughout Western New York and the Southern Tier. My entire campaign is fueled by giving a strong voice back to the people and fighting for you against the DC swamp.

You can find your polling location here to vote today: **[https://voterlookup.elections.ny.gov](https://CarlPaladino.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf22d0f57d54fb47b0038eb8&id=a91bb8a113&e=7e49f828ab)**

You know my story and proven conseravtive record. I was born and raised right here in Western New York, after serving in the Army, I started one of the most successful companies in our area, creating thousands of jobs. I was honored to serve as President Trump’s 2016 campaign chair and defeat the establishment. My track record is proven, and conseravtive. I was one of President Trump’s day one supporters, I defeated Albany and was able to get the tolls removed on 1-190, saving residents money. And right now, I am suing our radical Governor Kathy Hochul for her unconstitutional attack on your Second Amendment rights. We will win.

The Washington establishment does not want me to win, because they know I cannot be bought. My only interest is serving the great people of this district and being your voice in Congress. The liberal media has attempted to smear me, but voters are smart enough not to believe their lies. The truth is, if you turn out and vote, we will win. So, I am asking you to make a plan to vote today on Election Day. Let’s send a message to DC, that Western New York and the Southern Tier want a seat at the table, no more corrupt career politicians. My promise to you is that I will fight for you and deliver results for our community. Please vote today!

Sincerely,
Carl Paladino

| [](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.) Dear Friend of the Constitution, The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's **Second Amendment Survey** because you're someone who understands that education is essential to the defense of liberty. We are reaching and teaching millions of Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding. Could you take a few minutes to complete our **Second Amendment Survey** using the secure link below? **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-Q8vWYX0wwSemAXGP5BvQ "https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/")** Your timely survey answers will help us reach and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights protected by the Second Amendment. There is no question that one of the Left's most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our liberty is **ignorance**. Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in 1844. Today our educational outreach efforts include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty, such as the Second Amendment. As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler observed in _Imprimis_ , our digest of liberty that reaches millions of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of **first principles**." This means the Second Amendment is essential for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom. This kind of thinking is foreign to most college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an example... Not long ago, the University of Virginia canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day. Why? The administration was concerned that firing guns in honor of those who served their country and did their part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student body. Unfortunately, there are many more such examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the ongoing decline in civics education in America. **But instead of just TALKING, it's more important to DO something about it.** That's why we have been working to expand our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. And this work continues today. That's why I would like your answers to our brief **Second Amendment Survey.** You can complete the survey today at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-JZUUPg)** We believe that an educated citizenry is essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction." Do you agree? I hope so. This is why we **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution. It's also why we need your help today. As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. Our independence from the government means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. It also means your gift really matters. **Today, you have a great opportunity to help preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future generations.** After completing your **Second Amendment Survey** , please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous tax-deductible gift today. And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our thank you. This hat commemorates our partnership with USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited! Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed **Second Amendment Survey.** Warm regards, Larry P. ArnnPresident, Hillsdale CollegePursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
**P.S.** Our Constitution-including the Second Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take our **Second Amendment Survey** at the secure link below. It will only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve liberty for future generations. Thank you! **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)**

body:
Dear Reader,
In an effort to help you figure out exactly what's going to happen next in the financial markets...
And what you should be doing with your money right now...
We recently sent a film crew to Europe, to hear from one of the most successful entrepreneurs in America over the past 50 years... Bill Bonner.
[**(Click here to see what he told us.)**](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6b9f81feca8418f95760b83a4b0ef81&_e=isG_tZBC9_rG3G3-BRxql9Wogggi9vHiFr-qq5wmxpD5Wk8m6R_HDtjZV0ueO7NkmZYE6Myzyyl9cs57rR_FKqoPvzDuA_ajeoCysZhTstPgEDUfqX9EWZx8oSaeeWqdQCUgg3DclkFXjb9MVeV3F7AMv8LTsa3gHfzEfZ86bYuzu7NYWSv1JQvqnCJs3WIFLFCrsTLiIlsFGY4jWADYXwCCuPGTMXNHTzy258Z1PDZt65sgHfveKYCjqNXTxI2sl025QQBJHClRPzGVZkAbf9Y-CItLPdkbNp_L3mVii8fbs1sl3c-fOPNiwsW4vS44D35PZ4rNbjbEVyxlxKGgYeZOhrR7BF861nX61NoVLug%3D)
If you've never heard of Bonner, that's by design.
He's one of the most anti-social and reclusive men on the planet, who spends most of his time at his six massive properties... three in Europe... one in the U.S.... and one each in both Central and South America.
Over the past 40 years, Bonner built what is probably the largest financial research network on the planet. Along the way he's also written three _New York Times _best-selling books... and has launched offices in at least a dozen countries, including India, the UK... even China.
And today, Bonner is going on record with exactly what he believes is about to happen next in America...
He calls it his: **["4th and Final Prediction."](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6b9f81feca8418f95760b83a4b0ef81&_e=isG_tZBC9_rG3G3-BRxql9Wogggi9vHiFr-qq5wmxpD5Wk8m6R_HDtjZV0ueO7NkmZYE6Myzyyl9cs57rR_FKqoPvzDuA_ajeoCysZhTstPgEDUfqX9EWZx8oSaeeWqd8BBPV_dxgV3wWHCpdlr8F3BtaxUvbv_8D80S8xUlf3jZwnnhJ6GBh09-W2HYeWzcy388K7VYjaqXVSYIO8KKoN2TAyVmfn-f3Ze1MhyumPb5weElCqytu0SMgF9QzNkDxXMX8aUoK39HCVzvyAZdxt2h5-r9OuxuQZC21Tr_KViw4H99VHAwEIkMpmUmpJTYmfakWfH0WRtG_Dfg2cNnYEAc8uGckYAtCi86VjpXgqI%3D)**
Why should you care?

name: Harry, Team Andy
subject: It’s not hard to see why Andy’s opponent is against lowering prescription drug prices…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
I've lived in this district all my life.
I'm one of thousands in NJ-03 who have a chronic health condition that I have to take daily medication for. I'm lucky to have good insurance that helps to keep my costs relatively low. But too many in our district are forced to choose between putting food on the table or refilling their critical prescriptions. Some are even rationing their pills or skipping their medication altogether because it's simply too expensive.

That's unacceptable.

That's why Andy fights so hard in Congress to lower prescription drug prices and why we're thrilled that the Medicare spending cap he co-authored passed as part of the Inflation Reduction Act.

It's a big win, but there's even more we need to do to rein in Big Pharma. Will you chip in now to send Andy back to Congress to keep up the fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2022-08-23-pharmaprices&recurring=0&amount=13&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=3ecebd4c-fa22-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a]

But there's one thing that's even more unacceptable to me. Andy's opponent, Bob Healey, owns stock in several pharmaceutical companies. That means he's profiting off of those families struggling to choose between feeding their families or taking care of their health.

Healey absolutely refuses to divest those Big Pharma stocks. It's not hard to see why he opposes capping out-of-pocket costs and allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices.

We need someone in congress who will fight Big Pharma's profiteering, not join in. And we need someone who will fight to keep health care affordable for everyone. Donate now to keep Andy in Congress! clean_body: I've lived in this district all my life. I'm one of thousands in NJ-03 who have a chronic health condition that I have to take daily medication for. I'm lucky to have good insurance that helps to keep my costs relatively low. But too many in our district are forced to choose between putting food on the table or refilling their critical prescriptions. Some are even rationing their pills or skipping their medication altogether because it's simply too expensive. That's unacceptable. That's why Andy fights so hard in Congress to lower prescription drug prices and why we're thrilled that the Medicare spending cap he co-authored passed as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. It's a big win, but there's even more we need to do to rein in Big Pharma. Will you chip in now to send Andy back to Congress to keep up the fight? [] But there's one thing that's even more unacceptable to me. Andy's opponent, Bob Healey, owns stock in several pharmaceutical companies. That means he's profiting off of those families struggling to choose between feeding their families or taking care of their health. Healey absolutely refuses to divest those Big Pharma stocks. It's not hard to see why he opposes capping out-of-pocket costs and allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices. We need someone in congress who will fight Big Pharma's profiteering, not join in. And we need someone who will fight to keep health care affordable for everyone. Donate now to keep Andy in Congress! subject: New ATF Gun Control Starts August 24
body:
AFA is gearing up for a MASSIVE LEGAL BATTLE with Attorney General Merrick Garland and the DOJ / ATF!

Peter --

The first round of Joe Biden's gun control executive orders goes into effect this Wednesday (August 24), **and AFA is gearing up for a MASSIVE LEGAL BATTLE with Attorney General Merrick Garland and the DOJ / ATF!
** **1.** **Biden 's first Executive Order** makes it a felony to have a pistol brace attached to a firearm, making felons out of the 10-40 million Americans who already own these devices! **2.** **Biden 's second Executive Order** makes it a felony for a gunsmith to work on your homemade (80% lower style) firearm without attaching a serial number to it and notifying the NICS system -- the first step toward outlawing them all together. **3.** **Biden 's third Executive Order**** ** would redefine what a firearm receiver is and would mandate that a serial number be added to upper receivers for ALL future sales, allowing Biden to track them like he does lower receivers. This is the tyrannical government our forefathers warned us about. Not one of these orders was ever voted on by a member of Congress. This is gun control via fiat, pure and simple, designed to let Biden's ATF attack law abiding gun owners! But before I can turn our lawyers loose, I need to know that AFA's legal defense fund can cover the costs. **That 's why I am writing you today, to ask you to consider an immediate donation to help us sue Joe Biden.** | [HELP AFA SUE MERRICK GARLAND IN COURT!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61075758:JoeJebV5N:m:1:3317145305:5F3FBBD655E4412978EDD7BEF0F9CB1D:r)
---
While it's impossible for me to know the exact amount that we will ultimately need for this fight, our team expects that we'll need between $75,000 to $100,000 depending upon the number of briefs we'll file!
AFA prefers to fight for freedom using grassroots pressure in state legislatures and in the United States Congress. But we can't use those tactics here. We must take the fight into court.

**And we need to hurry.**

But this will be one hell of a fight. Our lawyers are ready to go, but our legal defense fund is not.
**Please make an immediate donation of $100, $50 or at least $25 today!**
[HELP AFA SUE MERRICK GARLAND IN COURT!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61075758:JoeJebV5N:m:1:3317145305:5F3FBBD655E4412978EDD7BEF0F9CB1D:r)

We are waging our final get out the vote push in the last few hours remaining...
| | | | | Friend
We are waging our final get out thevote push in the last few hours remaining, and Friend I want you to be a part of this!
I'm on the ground here in Florida's 3rd District, and I'm seeing incredible support for Republicans coming in today! Millions of dedicated and freedom-loving Floridians have shown out in huge numbers, but we still need thousands more to show out and help us keep Florida free before the polls close tonight!
Here is the link to help with our last-minute efforts: [https://secure.winred.com/katcammack/today-is-the-first-step](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eLh7CZMGmxgE4_aCla_is5k_RymuhhyoyZzB9pHbUwAjFGpr0p7ysze6D5uIgM3i389URf3ViPwBDeg70JLDAkT5alSlyM27HhoZeLbg1wK42b3Y99mw1hUg0I1omFL5uSzsreByeWYXjCS8K4PHzjTqivx6zUdSfi8inZakdnTkGrG8uYt8TMXcAARcStbLM62JTXmQBCtpB_PEBDwwLIyBnqeS5sE3&c=DAm6jdtWR9k6o2F6C0pHJwtmZ3oW2jnd7Fbz5yU3GrNzHLtdWwlyvA==&ch=Zgs-s_NTL0r4ZO4vhxhN_mX7QSpvApQd-H3BfY_YMw7BQzdPpmhR_w==)
Our goal to reach 4,000 voters before the polls close is still alive and strong, and you can help push it to the next level! Friend, I want to share an example of how our voting rights can be gradually eroded over time -- and how we can stop it.
Across the country, states have considered almost 400 voter suppression bills in 2022. The most extreme measures are often targeted and defeated early on. But those extreme bills also make somewhat less extreme bills seem reasonable by comparison.
It's an insidious trick, and a deliberate one: Flood the zone with lots of anti-voting rights bills, and hope one of them sneaks through. Fighting back against this strategy requires constant vigilance -- and that's where we need your help.

Donate $365 [] And we’ve also seen a lot change in these 365 days. Reproductive rights have been stripped away, public schools and educators are being attacked like never before, rural hospitals continue to close, and through all of this Governor Lee is complacent. If there has been one constant throughout this campaign, it’s the same thing that motivated me to run: a total failure of leadership from the governor’s office. Folks, we are entering the final months leading up to one of the most important elections Tennessee has ever faced. Are we going to choose to continue down this path of reckless and irresponsible leadership, or are we going to let our voices be heard at the ballot box and elect a governor for every Tennessean? I know we have what it takes to do it, and I’m counting on your support to make this vision a reality. Can you make a one year anniversary celebration contribution to help us defeat Bill Lee and give a voice to every Tennessean this November? [] Donate $365 [] Thank you for your support, as always. -Dr. Jason Martin [] [] www.martinfortn.com [] Paid for by Dr. Jason Martin for Tennessee Dr. Jason Martin for Tennessee 1831 12th Avenue S #175 Nashville, TN 37203 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
**And now I am taking on Biden’s CORRUPT FBI in a class action lawsuit for their ILLEGAL tactics against my clients who were in our Nation’s capital to peacefully protest on January 6th, 2021, but were treated like terrorists in the aftermath.
**
Many of my clients were rounded up, had their homes and businesses violated and broken into, and their property such as cell phones and computers seized WITHOUT PROBABLY CAUSE.

**They were arrested, prosecuted, denied bail, and some even thrown into solitary confinement while awaiting trial!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping our fellow Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their families...and kept from seeing their lawyers!

At least one January 6 protestor has already died.

A patriot grandmother with cancer was just sentenced to federal prison.

And let me tell you, if you and I don’t fight back against the corrupt politicians, bureaucrats, and law enforcement who are abusing our fellow patriots right now... _they will come for us next._

**[Patriot, please give a vital $5, $10, $25, $50, $100 or more IMMEDIATELY to help fully fund my TWO crucial lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to FREE ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS.
](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2b4rm2nggjf5isgueh98id3qlrkmo2pd7elkqlg_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9jmao74c1h2bs)**
I can’t stress how important it is to make the most of these historic lawsuits. Lots of other groups talk, but I fight. The January 6 protesters deserve nothing less.

**[Patriot, I’m counting on you for at least a special $25, 50 or more now...but every cent helps. Please give what you can.
](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7ul5t1mtrah03ht6f2k6tspnbkk8p056rhjgneg_rp22sh2s8i66or4c9jmao74c1h2bs)**

Larry Klayman

| | | | | Peter, **This anti-Semite casually insulted everyone who lost a loved one in the Holocaust, and I'm so sick of it.** **_Scott Jensen, the particular idiot the GOP nominated for Governor of Minnesota, yet again pulled the crap Republicans repeat like a tic--he compared live-saving, COVID-prevention measures to the Holocaust._** **It makes my blood boil.** **I’m too young to have known them, but my family lost numerous members to Adolf Hitler's genocidal regime,** and I can't tell you how much it enrages me when historically ignorant, casually stupid and completely cynical jackasses like Scott Jensen make this comparison. It is sick, really. [**This is about policy and culture. But I must also admit, for me, it's also personal. Will you please join me in sending a message that people like Jensen are UNACCEPTABLE in public service--anywhere, at any time--and consider giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to ensure Democratic Governor Tim Walz is reelected, and Scott Jensen ends up in the ash heap of history where he belongs?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4aa8731f-48b7-4652-bd19-4400e70e5958/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _The list is of obtuse, power-lusting Republicans who've done this is too long to name, but you know the most infamous ones: Marjorie Taylor Greene, Lauren Boebert, Madison Cawthorn and Scott Perry, all seditionists who helped Trump plan and cover up a bloody coup attempt on January 6th, and in Perry's case, an individual who has already had his phone confiscated as evidence by the FBI after the Mar-a-Lago raid._ **It’s no coincidence that those who casually, almost gleefully mention the Holocaust, are the very same ghouls who are trying to bring fascism to America, via armed rebellion if necessary.** Back to Jensen. As you can probably guess, _he also believes the 2020 election should have been overturned and his LT. Governor candiate on his ticket made abhorrent comment that "women always want to go to the rape card," mocking women wishing to terminate a pregnancy brought on by the ultimate act of violence against them. Jensen would ban all abortion except when *they* determine a woman's life is in danger. _ When you dig further into his record, his sociopathy becomes more and more apparent. _Jensen said he'd commute the sentence of former police officer Kim Potter, found guilty of executing African-American motorist Daunte Wright at a traffic stop in 2020._** This is a sick, deeply-racist individual who should be getting evaluated, not nominated to run for governor. But, ya know, today's Republican Party.**

#
Derek, at this point, you may have noticed that Dr. Oz is really bad at pretending to be a normal person.
So bad, in fact, that we created a translation guide for all the bizarrely out-of-touch things he’s said.

---
**When he says...** | **What he means is...**
“Crudité” | Literally just a veggie tray.
“Legitimately, I own two houses” | I own 10 houses. I’m lying.
“So the guy I use is a Turkish tailor and he uses Zegna fabrics” | Not only do I own multiple custom-made suits, they’re made out of this luxury Italian wool (we had to Google this one)
