[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b700327889cf4ab49aed4824f85d80f6&_e=CjsB4ABijOllYep28ZqXssDhIgeCTGKBMTFX0iFrfYiuEQeK2TtJLIBAu3s9UzgDh5W7dDb4A8u19Wvx5DzZXJwSsKxH11-HVmQaGaYZu3OyDF5N7OAveBwYYY1auMYHOyOk1GNfRoqyaY9-82Q6FyPK-Dz4uTVK8iMG0FZB1d7oRiqqtk_pKrz4vxbmdTubZ2I-WE5328uJPDxjlyeq0-l6XHyVSQhDLBedgHaIA0K8qE_lqMRH-jaz8LK0shyUoqob5IQS49Uqwq9kjThMTXCR5fK36L5b4CyTgm6v3aihUfp1S892Cr17FNTWWwgtsFv6UjcT5WxVv3TZlzg2l355U1f01VnP2cUlGMm6y38%3D)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b700327889cf4ab49aed4824f85d80f6&_e=CjsB4ABijOllYep28ZqXssDhIgeCTGKBMTFX0iFrfYiuEQeK2TtJLIBAu3s9UzgDh5W7dDb4A8u19Wvx5DzZXJwSsKxH11-HVmQaGaYZu3OyDF5N7OAveBwYYY1auMYHOyOk1GNfRoqyaY9-82Q6FyPZ6srvZ1g1cChwNCLYegw7BLQvvlq9SA_L1haXLpvsYvxv_UJzKqd9kFn4eORRzNK5wtT6bNWIf-9RRZLngvSo0juOLJU81f0n3b9K6oynLuRYRRGpTlN9GmafejQCmhTq5vXaQdXig8t5ZjsOyfxQcMrSLng2tlYG2GTUJ2Iga6LSRQnIVBaJJ2IkrbR5t1CR8DbivVzs1ZRUCCDa_4s%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b700327889cf4ab49aed4824f85d80f6&_e=CjsB4ABijOllYep28ZqXssDhIgeCTGKBMTFX0iFrfYiuEQeK2TtJLIBAu3s9UzgDh5W7dDb4A8u19Wvx5DzZXJwSsKxH11-HVmQaGaYZu3OyDF5N7OAveBwYYY1auMYHOyOk1GNfRoqyaY9-82Q6Fz1rrGvdgIWoKreOevJPSD0sJcJSERH0ME4BwYKhm4Jyul0aJwAGyMmSQNHnt4ukoup982g3fhQ1gsNSQ74FhehqrGCgMEfGpzcIPwnDrogVCQBlMQTKxJntGeIXg-zCGi1bs0ZetEVMhE6vHN1aSQaswo0DbrMhv92UrB9mk0ahRvO6bqSU6kUHTD13TUULcCpK-lebQIgtT6TD_gaylLM%3D)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

[**If you 're with me in the fight to keep both my seat and the Senate blue, please donate $5 now to become one of the 5,000 General Election Founding Donors we need before tomorrow's critical fundraising deadline.**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1238-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500) [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1238-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)

Dick

name: Sheriff Joe Lombardo
subject: Reminding you what I stand for.
body:
The things I stand for in my run for Governor are the same things I’ve stood for throughout my 30+ years as a law enforcement officer.
| | | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kQfI9Zp66xptr-NveQyG1JtecLsucGn5no_Cbc8M_p0rQLyCNxEDpmMKDtczlOV2X5fr_FeuhlV06eCK0QKC_zwgXO9jk7WpipK65VKOIZrOR4simCJfnqmfu0JYOISHUP0FfgqIEOWfKzNpDWS_7FmswIz3F07VX3OG4sZbHU0ryrBOFopHwHrcuighx388RIo1BmtrXgKUGhncY2yDgZXEgFMmQ591XWx3s93k9JC4SaPfM6ol8g==&c=uh12m-jI2wIOXiOH3oVCg4wRgLoelbKicXskfqBxzSwF6bjU2CXMvQ==&ch=5jfABiOEwA5Z4scNBWFaYwJq1KsAmXshM605HiyM0rWZIpfQaiMaDQ==)
---
| Peter,
The things I stand for in my run for Governor are the same things I've stood for throughout my 30+ years as a law enforcement officer.
I want to protect our freedoms, keep our streets safe, and make our communities a great place to live and raise a family.
It sounds simple, but these are things that Steve Sisolak has failed to provide. He's given us nothing but corruption and scandals, inflation that's even higher than the national average, and the release of violent criminals onto our streets...
That's why I had to take action and stop this from getting worse. I'm not a politician - I'm someone who wants the best for my community, and can see that Steve Sisolak is clearly FAILING at this important task.

I want to protect our freedoms, keep our streets safe, and make our communities a great place to live and raise a family. He's given us nothing but corruption and scandals, inflation that's even higher than the national average, and the release of violent criminals onto our streets... Megaflood in CA is twice as likely, thanks to climate change, reports say

Did you know, friend? In 1862, a massive flood in California created a **300-mile-long sea** spanning the Central Valley and putting some places 20 feet underwater.

Now, the likelihood of another monstrous flood hitting California in the next 40 years has _doubled_ **due to climate change**. It’s difficult to imagine the level of devastation that would occur.

It's also difficult to understand why Rick Caruso — a person who thinks he's qualified to be mayor of the second-largest city in America — thinks he can run for office with ZERO environmental platform to stand on. Yes, Rick, give us nothing!

It’s not too late to take action and mitigate climate change, but **we must act NOW for future generations. And unlike Rick,[Karen has a bold plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49639679/362924457/1454842613?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjk0NzAzNi0xNTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C7wJCxcUyBUbsIJxlMqWuPhJ4vNJtumRfe680fgPj_Q=&emci=2f85c0c0-0423-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=2b947036-1523-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742) to put Los Angeles at the forefront of addressing climate change.**

[I’m asking you to invest $60 to my campaign today so I can get to work fighting inflation.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=169f2a7414&e=7dd0b93d07)

Sean Casten shrugs his shoulders, but I’ll roll up my sleeves and fight to put people over politics. While Casten has prioritized special interests in Washington, I will put people over politics. Just as I have in Orland Park, I will fight against the petty politics and corrosive special interest groups in Congress.

But to fight back against Sean Casten’s army of special interest groups, I need your support today! [Your $60 investment today](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=c1397f647a&e=7dd0b93d07) helps us connect with voters across the district who have gone unrepresented by an apathetic Casten for far too long.

It takes an army of supporters to fight back against Casten’s army of special interests. [Can I count on you to join me by chipping in $60 today?](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=f08e881bb5&e=7dd0b93d07)

Together, we’ll restore common sense leadership and fiscal responsibility in Congress.

Thank you!

Keith Pekau

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, AUGUST 23
ICYMI: INSIDER ADVANTAGE FEATURES CITIZENS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA
(ATLANTA) - In case you missed it, Insider Advantage featured Citizens for a Greater Georgia last week - highlighting the group's efforts to reach more than 200,000 voters in its first 90 days of operation. Citizens for a Greater Georgia, which has deployed a statewide field program to elect Republican State Senate candidates, has reached over 46,000 voters at the doors and over 156,000 voters on the phones - in addition to hosting dozens of grassroots mobilization events.
To view the full article click [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FMfluvoy6uTtuChBhP-MA8Cl4lTmwIlroA8F7JtSYlPmvJnZIJyfyxGHC2EWEPnAzv1iWlCvMR7E4T7JYBPyPtgB0rPMHC8Mt4sYfNTa-ZrL7aY6hwG068yB3QClxzaXyI-4Zp2KCE_uy1eRWQ72onMxbgUwiWQ7F2LMV-7gd8iNkONrzPkR0wc6erK6GxpBSmZgc0hBGOLxZnpXfmnJ4R86X1TDE7lrUcB1A9N5kjZlcJTt2MCw4OHipRgzdK_G&c=16D2uEtJypcG3SxoL8k846PGZOJiVEC1NmdwLhaMEsx-4dwb4jlA0Q==&ch=yTOxeQvqi9EnI9UluSe50XU4mrbwpAk_BHsDFi52yj6tYXNvdNSAgg==), or read the excerpt below:
"Several months ago Georgia Republicans announced a new partnership designed to preserve and grow the majority in the Senate. Building on former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler's Greater Georgia - a voter mobilization group - the Georgia Senate Majority Caucus launched two new leadership committees who will be working toward the success of Republicans across the state. One of the committees - Citizens for a Greater Georgia- represents a partnership between the Georgia State Senate Majority Caucus and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler.
Thursday morning, Citizens for a Greater Georgia announced that it has made over 200,000 voter contacts since launching its statewide field program in June. The program, which is currently anchored by two-dozen paid field operatives, is dedicated to mobilizing disenfranchised, disengaged, and newly registered voters in key State Senate districts across the state. Of the 200,000 reached, 46,522 voters were reached at their homes and 156,165 voters were reached by phone."

Derek -- I got my start in politics way back when I was in high school in South Carolina. I’d help register voters throughout my community so they could participate in our democracy, and I realized what a significant impact it had on folks in my hometown of Orangeburg and families across the country. I’ve learned so much since then -- particularly during my Senate race against Lindsey Graham -- but there’s one thing that’s stuck with me from the get-go: **When we work together, we can deliver real, lasting change.** Now, with fewer than 100 days until the midterm elections, our party is at a critical inflection point. **Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today? I’ve learned so much since then -- particularly during my Senate race against Lindsey Graham -- but there’s one thing that’s stuck with me from the get-go: When we work together, we can deliver real, lasting change. Now, with fewer than 100 days until the midterm elections, our party is at a critical inflection point. Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today? If we hold our congressional majorities, that’s not just a victory for Democrats but for the American people. clean_body: Polling is SO CLOSE in Georgia, but we’re outspent and outraised. Help us fight back. | Hey, Fellow American - I wanted to make a point of personally reaching out to you today. Polling in this tight Georgia Senate race has shown me down by three points, tied, or - most recently - up by one point. These polls all have one thing in common: MARGIN OF ERROR VIRTUAL TIE TOSS-UP Here's the amazing part: my Democrat opponent and his Super PAC allies have spent over $25 million in false and misleading attack ads against me since I won the Republican nomination in May. Democrats expected to have a blowout lead by Labor Day. Instead, we're approaching fall with the race still a virtual tie. There's no denying it: this race will come down to the wire. With so much at stake, This race isn't just about Georgians. Whoever wins in Georgia will determine the balance of power in the Senate, so this race affects EVERY AMERICAN. I'm doing everything I can to win and put America first again, but Senator Warnock is breaking fundraising and spending records. The polls will go up and down a bit over the next 11 weeks, but one thing is clear: we cannot afford to continue being massively outraised and outspent. It's critical to make sure our ads are on the air ASAP to connect with the voters who will determine this election. Thanks, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Southern Minnesotans deserve a real advocate who’ll work across party lines to solve the big issues affecting working families. I’m taking on Brad Finstad to be that advocate. ETTINGER FOR CONGRESS

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49641823/362933569/-895462045?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZDQ4OWZmMS0xYzIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HGpyaK4JK5q2KHHrhPmQCOZTZ02haAuVUrlgIlebkT8=&emci=87b6c438-0123-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=3d489ff1-1c23-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5460736) Hi friend, Lowering costs for working families is a priority of mine. That’s why I put together an [inflation reduction plan with 10 different strategies](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49641825/362933571/-1080654751?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZDQ4OWZmMS0xYzIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HGpyaK4JK5q2KHHrhPmQCOZTZ02haAuVUrlgIlebkT8=&emci=87b6c438-0123-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=3d489ff1-1c23-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5460736), including:

* Lowering the cost of prescription drugs by letting the government negotiate lower rates—a policy Finstad voted against on his very first day in office.

* Lowering the cost of grocery bills by supporting small-scale butchers and processors in Southern Minnesota and across the county.

* Making more things in America so that supply chain disruptions don’t spike prices for everyday items.

body:
| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_v1&n=1)

Friend – Today marks two years since the Kenosha riots that resulted in over 100 businesses damaged and a community rocked forever. Today we remember the widespread lawlessness, mob violence, and destruction – and we must never forget the role that Tony Evers played in fanning the flames. [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZY26dPdYnxDsCgoMK63kO4&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_v1&n=2)[**Tony Evers Has “No Regrets”**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZY26dPdYnxDsCgoMK63kO4&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_v1&n=3) Wisconsinites in Kenosha won’t forget the role that Tony Evers’ inaction played in the destruction of their community. Two years ago, Tony Evers played politics with public safety when he rejected President Trump’s offer of federal help from the Department of Homeland Security. When the Kenosha County Board asked Evers for 1,500 National Guard troops, Evers short changed them with only 500.**** Tony Evers sided with the fringe-left instead of the people of Kenosha. Nonetheless, Evers said that he had [**“no regrets”**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZY26dPdYnxDsCgoMK63kO4&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_v1&n=4) about his inaction. **** It’s time to elect a governor who will put public safety first. We hope you will join us in thinking about the people of Kenosha today – and we hope you’ll join us in holding Evers accountable at the ballot box this November.**** \- Team WisGOP****

Hi Peter, it’s Tammy Duckworth.
I’m up for re-election and [_**asking for whatever support you can spare**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49641911/362934522/-1910930024?refcode=dd_em_220823_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk0NzI4Ni0xZDIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bifD7jq8aUS4nDHc6Q_MHOufZIbtVrpgOB7csLDCWqE=), but I wanted to take the time to reach out and explain _why_ I’m running for re-election.
When I was a kid, the company my dad worked for was sold. He lost his job and my family was eventually forced onto public assistance. My brother and I relied on reduced-price meals at our public school and we used food stamps – until they ran out towards the end of the month – to put dinner on the table. It was tough, and we probably wouldn’t have made it through without government support.
So when Senator Durbin encouraged me to run for public office, I dove right in to advocate for Veterans and working families. It’s been the honor of my life to serve alongside Senator Durbin and work for Illinoisans every day.
Now, as too many families in Illinois and across the country are struggling with higher costs and wages that aren’t keeping up, Senator Durbin and I are working for cheaper prescription drugs, more affordable health care and more support.
In the past year, we’ve made great progress with critical legislation like the American Rescue Plan, the bipartisan infrastructure law, the Inflation Reduction Act, and more. **But our work is far from over – and we know that.**
**[Can I count on you to split a contribution of $5 between my campaign and Senator Durbin’s right now to help us keep fiercely advocating for working families?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49641912/362934524/-1910930024?refcode=dd_em_220823_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDk0NzI4Ni0xZDIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bifD7jq8aUS4nDHc6Q_MHOufZIbtVrpgOB7csLDCWqE=)**
Especially now, your support means a world of difference.
Thank you,
Tammy Duckworth

body:
Derek,

Working with Lt. Governor Mandela Barnes has been one of the great honors
of my life.

Together, we've improved our public schools, stopped voter suppression,
overcome COVID-19 conspiracy theories, and defended Wisconsin against
extreme policies.

Mandela is currently running for the US Senate against Ron Johnson. Like
my opponent, Tim Michels, Ron Johnson is an extremist who values his
relationship with Donald Trump more than American values or the
Constitution.

When Trump’s team needed someone in the Senate to deliver fake electors to
Mike Pence on January 6th, Johnson was their man.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1507?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20220823_1_1&t=1001&akid=4190%2E1827488%2EtQe4If ]Mandela and I are both running against extremist opponents who want to
end fair elections and abortion rights. Can I count on you to chip in to
split a donation between our campaigns?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation
will be split between Tony Evers and Mandela Barnes and process immediately.

Mandela is one of the most innovative and talented natural organizers I've
ever seen.

He grew up in Milwaukee in one of Wisconsin's most impoverished and
incarcerated zip codes. His dad worked the 3rd shift at the General Motors
factory, and his mom was a Milwaukee school teacher for 30 years. His
union parents taught him the value of hard work and the importance of
sticking up for our rights.

From there, Mandela improbably became one of Wisconsin's youngest members
of the legislature and immediately made his presence felt.

And, as my trusted partner, he's been solid as a rock -- helping me
improve our state while blocking extreme voter suppression laws.

Onward,

Tony

Kim has been working hard in Congress to pass legislation that addresses the issues that matter most to you. Since today is her birthday, we wanted to do something special to show her how much we appreciate her hard work.

# VOTE TODAY
Today’s the day to make your voice heard!We would like to thank everyone for their support thus far. This road, although it has not been easy, was entirely worth it. We need an advocate to fight for the communities on Long Island’s South Shore. Communities that for far too long have been overlooked, communities that are suffering from lack of funding, lack of public safety and poor infrastructure. It will be my honor to be your voice in Congress. It would be my honor to get your vote **today**. We have been working very hard, reaching out to residents letting them know about this election. However, it’s an incredibly odd time for an election because elections don’t typically happen in August. This is why we really need every single one of our supporters to come out and vote.Not just yourself, vote with your whole family, vote with your friends. This is a very important time and this is a history making election. This is our opportunity to get representation in Congress for Caribbean Americans. To get representation in Congress for marginalized communities who often don’t get their fair share from our government despite being valued tax paying citizens. If you haven’t gotten the chance yet, please go out and **VOTE**. If you need help, find your polling place [**here**](https://solagesforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60f879846c19417c4bab5220c&id=5ac5f7cffd&e=0c821b2b94). Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

subject: Here's what the Inflation Reduction Act means for climate justice:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
Rebuilding our economy and protecting our environment go hand in hand.
Peter,

Our region is already experiencing the devastating effects of climate change every single day. We need to take immediate action to combat the climate crisis, and Derek is leading the fight in Congress.

Earlier this month, Derek voted to pass the historic Inflation Reduction Act through the House. **Peter****, this is the largest and most significant investment in climate resilience and environmental justice in America 's history. **

Here's what the IRA means for the fight against climate change:
* Invests in forest and coastal restoration, and resilient agriculture;
* Will cut pollution by 40 percent below 2005 levels by 2030;
* Will set industry-wide limits on methane leakage -- **oil and gas companies that emit above a certain level of methane across all operations will trigger a fee that will escalate over time;**
* Invests in environmental justice priorities, including pollution reduction;
* Incentivizes domestic manufacturing of clean energy.

The IRA is a huge victory, but it should only be the first step if we're going to protect our natural resources and combat climate change for future generations.

**[Rebuilding our economy and protecting our environment go hand in hand. We can't move forward on one issue without addressing the other. | Hi Peter,

One of my campaign volunteers remembers seeing President Eisenhower

on his family's black and white TV around 1957.

Knowing that was the President, he immediately stood up straight

and saluted the TV!

Lots of people wonder whatever happened to THAT America...

...where a 5 year old knew enough to honor the American President.

The answer is: it was SWALLOWED WHOLE by the political machine in Washington DC.

**Peter, t**** _oday, we live in a world controlled by this political machine ...

...where people in Congress never call a bill what it really is._**

They call it the **"****INFLATION REDUCTION ACT** "...

....when it really should be called the

"**Spending $580 Billion in Total, giving $402 Billion in"Green Energy", While Raising $40 Billion More in Taxes ACT."***

It's no wonder**fewer than 1 in 5 Americans approve** of the U.S. Congress today, and less than 40% approve of our current President.

This will all change, Peter.

I'm Courtney Geels and I am a nurse running to represent you in Congress...

Together, can we do away with career politicians...

...and return to making our country proud of its Congress again.

Bankrupting the Fake News empire will not be easy.

You and I must take action to save our Republic, our values, and our Constitution from the den of vipers that makes up the Fake News media.

My goal is to raise $50,000 in the next 48 hours to combat CNN and other Fake News media outlets.

**Here 's the best part of all of this... _Our plan is already working_. **

body:
AFA is gearing up for a MASSIVE LEGAL BATTLE with Attorney General Merrick Garland and the DOJ / ATF!

Peter --

The first round of Joe Biden's gun control executive orders goes into effect this Wednesday (August 24), **and AFA is gearing up for a MASSIVE LEGAL BATTLE with Attorney General Merrick Garland and the DOJ / ATF!
** **1.** **Biden 's first Executive Order** makes it a felony to have a pistol brace attached to a firearm, making felons out of the 10-40 million Americans who already own these devices! **2.** **Biden 's second Executive Order** makes it a felony for a gunsmith to work on your homemade (80% lower style) firearm without attaching a serial number to it and notifying the NICS system -- the first step toward outlawing them all together. **3.** **Biden 's third Executive Order**** ** would redefine what a firearm receiver is and would mandate that a serial number be added to upper receivers for ALL future sales, allowing Biden to track them like he does lower receivers. This is the tyrannical government our forefathers warned us about. Not one of these orders was ever voted on by a member of Congress. This is gun control via fiat, pure and simple, designed to let Biden's ATF attack law abiding gun owners! But before I can turn our lawyers loose, I need to know that AFA's legal defense fund can cover the costs. **That 's why I am writing you today, to ask you to consider an immediate donation to help us sue Joe Biden.** | [HELP AFA SUE MERRICK GARLAND IN COURT!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61078604:J5668uVNp:m:1:3253819041:047EB79C027DD84159D992FAFC00F261:r)
---
While it's impossible for me to know the exact amount that we will ultimately need for this fight, our team expects that we'll need between $75,000 to $100,000 depending upon the number of briefs we'll file!
AFA prefers to fight for freedom using grassroots pressure in state legislatures and in the United States Congress. But we can't use those tactics here. We must take the fight into court.

**And we need to hurry.**

But this will be one hell of a fight. Our lawyers are ready to go, but our legal defense fund is not.
**Please make an immediate donation of $100, $50 or at least $25 today!**
[HELP AFA SUE MERRICK GARLAND IN COURT!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61078604:J5668uVNp:m:1:3253819041:047EB79C027DD84159D992FAFC00F261:r)
---

**
**
Christopher Dorr, ****President**

| | Peter —

When the FBI raided Mar-a-Lago, it was for a simple purpose: to obtain top secret, highly classified documents Trump took from the White House and refused to return as required of every president by law.

Republicans' responses have been _haphazard and dangerous_. Almost immediately, they started calling for the FBI to be defunded and made racist, completely false claims about President Obama. Many members of Congress called this a “political witch hunt.”

We need our elected officials to be law-makers, not law-breakers.

This isn't the first time Trump may have broken the law. While in office, he reportedly ripped up documents, flushing them down the toilet and instructing White House staffers to place them in "burn bags" earmarked for destruction.

My goal is to raise $50,000 in the next 48 hours to combat CNN and other Fake News media outlets.

| | Friend, Welcome! As chair of the Democratic Party of Wisconsin, I am excited to have you join our team. It’s because of supporters like YOU that we won Wisconsin in 2020 and stopped any chance of Trump winning an electoral college victory.

Every dollar that was chipped in. Every call that was made. Every text that was sent. With a margin of roughly 20,000 votes, everything made a difference and we couldn’t be more grateful. _But ahead of another competitive election cycle, we were just getting started._

We supported and won local elections across the state in 2021 - like Ryan Sorenson (now Sheboygan’s youngest mayor ever!), Emily Siegrist for Brown Deer Village Board, Sachin Shivaram for Ledgeview Town Board, and Auntavia Jackson for Racine Unified School District. We’ve built the bench - _and we’re just getting started_ . **This year, we’ll fight in every race from the State Assembly to defeating U.S. Senator Ron Johnson to — critically — re-electing Governor Tony Evers.**

Wisconsin is the nation’s most closely-divided electoral battleground. We expect the 2022 elections to be extraordinarily tough, but if we do all that we can, they will be winnable. It’s not an exaggeration to say that—once again— _the future of American democracy hinges on what happens in Wisconsin._

clean_body: Trump is on the campaign trail again. | | | Hi Peter, My name is Tony Evers, and I am running for re-election as the governor of Wisconsin. Right now, Trump is on the campaign trail, and just the other week, he was in my home state. That means he went around attacking me and my record as governor as he tried to make sure his right-wing, GOP candidates win. We know facts don’t matter to Trump - he has to lie about my record. That is why we have to make sure we’re ready to respond before the end of the month deadline hits. Trump’s pick for governor has refused to rule out overturning the 2020 election results in Wisconsin and during the latest debate, he called to cut funding for our schools. We can’t let Trump and his pick win. Friends,

I thought I’d take a second to tell you how I got here – running for the U.S. Senate. There’s so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=b665a9351e1d47f4acab6a2fc54172c8&_e=R0XF1-Ys7lv94UMCOtTLySy4x4u6hfgESNQnLNGPKujcHFj8VAflU2PJoyrBUhFQ9FG6vu4xFmuZP212VU74z0xAQ5ksrLnVlPT2c62z9hKoOw2AFuDOoUa5hJbOos1otZcO5ajKTiSd8Bqh8_YcWHObzpXOblZl0LXmeOY-zfvBJEDR8R72fuDURNGD8iOuVo2KYWzycE7IEecScc6CbXdposMbPHwC9TnFK9DM_N-MQwQyT0DV-FWv1RVvdK2JmarfhqsTaHu_shItyF6B548FC_buNB9izgeVNenah0mn__P6ZpyUclQx1IGVTBb69lD63bGGih1oP8jb_gQ1hAG8DYlg1wxIZHtLjaigh4egnQp9f9yUAtJTT3ctFoie5DuN_YJ_6RG3s7PxENxB9vsX7j5DwLLcCvaOs8nP44Gjcs7bKj0WzB2NLuEUsKQuoHxq9SZH0zp10YgSONuNdMIM5zg2R3ZjDWhvp2gjsTOgqgsQidWoHmfbSLXRWFIXfWuQBqfspL9tJUqOph8BsyYn6ahnDdc7R16K_6qepSA%3D)
This is a photo of my sister, Lindsay, and me. We grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. We grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=b665a9351e1d47f4acab6a2fc54172c8&_e=R0XF1-Ys7lv94UMCOtTLySy4x4u6hfgESNQnLNGPKujcHFj8VAflU2PJoyrBUhFQ9FG6vu4xFmuZP212VU74z0xAQ5ksrLnVlPT2c62z9hKoOw2AFuDOoUa5hJbOos1otZcO5ajKTiSd8Bqh8_YcWHObzpXOblZl0LXmeOY-zfvBJEDR8R72fuDURNGD8iOuVo2KYWzycE7IEecScc6CbXdposMbPHwC9TnFK9DM_N-MQwQyT0DV-FWv1RVvdK2JmarfhqsTaHu_shItyF6B548FC_buNB9izgeVNenah0mn__P6ZpyUclQx1IGVTBb69lD63bGGih1oP8jb_gQ1hOBbdS-Aa2EpLjhP7jBRQApL2zMnBCIh2vGizJRbFt_D3GzSK7FZwvMAVwkHNggLDYeXbBYiE_Q4Ua1R58-y9ZCv_CEGyeaA766JFDDYbv-Wy5ER0X7G_lxnWrslwlOqLrWKmcF1_x0UsRtfuGnlR38pO_KiL70B_6V_RFk1cHcX0l3nq1wHat7qPVXyYy2FarteS-xEmektdi4gbDisWj4%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents – Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=b665a9351e1d47f4acab6a2fc54172c8&_e=R0XF1-Ys7lv94UMCOtTLySy4x4u6hfgESNQnLNGPKujcHFj8VAflU2PJoyrBUhFQ9FG6vu4xFmuZP212VU74z0xAQ5ksrLnVlPT2c62z9hKoOw2AFuDOoUa5hJbOos1otZcO5ajKTiSd8Bqh8_YcWHObzpXOblZl0LXmeOY-zfvBJEDR8R72fuDURNGD8iOuVo2KYWzycE7IEecScc6CbXdposMbPHwC9TnFK9DM_N-MQwQyT0DV-FWv1RVvdK2JmarfhqsTaHu_shItyF6B548FC_buNB9izgeVNenah0mn__P6ZpyUclQx1IGVTBb69lD63bGGih1oP8jb_gQ1hAMizCZ26ZXuDTSc4ZX4pojsbPSDQPZ5mSHmzv1NMULKnUXNbFcCDiYTyx8tWFune1yoDIni6G-FRpywt64HbrvtpR0OKJnSr42r00hO43gM52IcLVCuKitRVV1byP0_RMDdRcMoBa69Qf59nvhBWZ8pwuO1uHA8no2FqbKU3QuMQ5ZR5PLr8r-PxXJPM20QKki7HjcVrtm-fHY4Jn8Z7z8%3D)
After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=b665a9351e1d47f4acab6a2fc54172c8&_e=R0XF1-Ys7lv94UMCOtTLySy4x4u6hfgESNQnLNGPKujcHFj8VAflU2PJoyrBUhFQ9FG6vu4xFmuZP212VU74z0xAQ5ksrLnVlPT2c62z9hKoOw2AFuDOoUa5hJbOos1otZcO5ajKTiSd8Bqh8_YcWHObzpXOblZl0LXmeOY-zfvBJEDR8R72fuDURNGD8iOuVo2KYWzycE7IEecScc6CbXdposMbPHwC9TnFK9DM_N-MQwQyT0DV-FWv1RVvdK2JmarfhqsTaHu_shItyF6B548FC_buNB9izgeVNenah0mn__P6ZpyUclQx1IGVTBb69lD63bGGih1oP8jb_gQ1hPCNuZ27QVUYjLAC9FdMwr6COVA5oMwZvRuYI7kex_61PMMGyxS9ag-fqzptBwK0YzU6gnA6XMzYGbi_hy3U3kB3ZM1OmpxJv_NyDb3lZQaYGLWFmkJ6GgPs3fA1CYfBvAIY3YWmpvm_PsWd-nGfumb_uh7cHR0RC4JLUm3G03gGEhfWzHJhvXzULRjI5CaQtrPcClLBBGbL6vmpP2Aha_0%3D)
I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=b665a9351e1d47f4acab6a2fc54172c8&_e=R0XF1-Ys7lv94UMCOtTLySy4x4u6hfgESNQnLNGPKujcHFj8VAflU2PJoyrBUhFQ9FG6vu4xFmuZP212VU74z0xAQ5ksrLnVlPT2c62z9hKoOw2AFuDOoUa5hJbOos1otZcO5ajKTiSd8Bqh8_YcWHObzpXOblZl0LXmeOY-zfvBJEDR8R72fuDURNGD8iOuVo2KYWzycE7IEecScc6CbXdposMbPHwC9TnFK9DM_N-MQwQyT0DV-FWv1RVvdK2JmarfhqsTaHu_shItyF6B548FC_buNB9izgeVNenah0mn__P6ZpyUclQx1IGVTBb69lD63bGGih1oP8jb_gQ1hMXlQ491Nunpnh-IT5oBXjrHHovRv23lCPmQapv-TYny8Wiu96WOu6hcv3EzOYuxoRylmPU2gKtHY9eCf2ttA95yejurFZHLJOuRpp_SNBo6JeI1U_RlhEyElEfAKf24XV_lZPvgYme9cutilw7bt9b2w6nb_JYSF_ucUwZFQSuNol1ES6uFjzvTRgFuPxLq0RCVJ3fDZ78qkjpSHzD5nyI%3D)
All of this brought me to where I am right now – campaigning to be Ohio’s next Senator. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I’ve seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent.

I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately – they fail themselves. It’s an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots – my family – my hometown – are what got me here. The good and the bad.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=b665a9351e1d47f4acab6a2fc54172c8&_e=R0XF1-Ys7lv94UMCOtTLySy4x4u6hfgESNQnLNGPKujcHFj8VAflU2PJoyrBUhFQ9FG6vu4xFmuZP212VU74z0xAQ5ksrLnVlPT2c62z9hKoOw2AFuDOoUa5hJbOos1otZcO5ajKTiSd8Bqh8_YcWHObzpXOblZl0LXmeOY-zfvBJEDR8R72fuDURNGD8iOuVo2KYWzycE7IEecScc6CbXdposMbPHwC9TnFK9DM_N-MQwQyT0DV-FWv1RVvdK2JmarfhqsTaHu_shItyF6B548FC_buNB9izgeVNenah0mn__P6ZpyUclQx1IGVTBb69lD63bGGih1oP8jb_gQ1hBaaQXHyQcE6GstWb8gc-LiEDcRweXk96A2KGlo23omVOt3eTMGiIFfjSIkBPiHm1pW2uNT-MepBHv5AaH1agnVz72MhLI2lH4YIFtoYRg1M80KPuPncOGbwkqg1EAf37JVJc4EGN8xDX9Pe3qWlEkAR4keIIjJPXMix5m8_zrk8JmmRWhhcxNUFGPF0MGVwg0JwREsyll0SimcN4up7-Hc%3D)
I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs someone who knows what it’s like to live in a left-behind community, not a career politician who has done nothing for the people of Ohio.

I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of this campaign: **leave no Ohioan behind.**

[**_It would be the honor of my life to serve you in the Senate, and I hope you can make a donation today. It would truly mean the world to me._**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=b665a9351e1d47f4acab6a2fc54172c8&_e=R0XF1-Ys7lv94UMCOtTLySy4x4u6hfgESNQnLNGPKujcHFj8VAflU2PJoyrBUhFQ9FG6vu4xFmuZP212VU74z0xAQ5ksrLnVlPT2c62z9hKoOw2AFuDOoUa5hJbOos1otZcO5ajKTiSd8Bqh8_YcWHObzpXOblZl0LXmeOY-zfvBJEDR8R72fuDURNGD8iOuVo2KYWzycE7IEecScc6CbXdposMbPHwC9TnFK9DM_N-MQwQyT0DV-FWv1RVvdK2JmarfhqsTaHu_shItyF6B548FC_buNB9izgeVNenah0mn__P6ZpyUclQx1IGVTBb69lD63bGGih1oP8jb_gQ1hHs9TgW07SwzlhuRnAn8hPPhDgq567O_pnF07JpgCCXdidyONdpUd3FiN3Bbqe5nzGIOsIK7UOyedrBarUQOdFkhuS_O7YXs5BmxExvShlhzydF78u3MYnQpQWg9GjGUSXobJ6bMbXaFAWoLYkrL8MWnMMMfhc5UB30RE_61o-2T2g7rwHDogyXWUZ0hnVE5xsu2MIPJcBjXjDLyp-cwhkc%3D)

JD Vance

clean_body: Sparknotes | Friends, I thought I’d take a second to tell you how I got here – running for the U.S. Senate. There’s so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my Hillbilly Elegy. This is a photo of my sister, Lindsay, and me. We grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. We grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop. My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents – Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream. After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University. I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together. All of this brought me to where I am right now – campaigning to be Ohio’s next Senator. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I’ve seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent. I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately – they fail themselves. It’s an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots – my family – my hometown – are what got me here. The good and the bad. I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs someone who knows what it’s like to live in a left-behind community, not a career politician who has done nothing for the people of Ohio. I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of this campaign: leave no Ohioan behind. Thank you so much for taking the time to read. God bless, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. Ohio needs JD Vance. clean_body: | Peter, This past week, it was my opponent Jahana Hayes’ turn to be interviewed on the Real Story , and it left me with many questions and great concern. Here’s why: When Hayes first ran in 2018, she pledged never to take any corporate money - but since she’s been in office, she has taken at least $100,000 from some of our nation’s largest corporations. She hesitated and redirected her response on whether she would support Biden in 2024, but by the end of it, Hayes stated that she would vote for Biden, despite his plummeting approval rating. When asked about Hayes paying her children with campaign finances, all she said was that it wasn’t illegal. She couldn’t even state what role they play in her campaign! Shouldn’t we be worried about having an elected official who is flip-flopping, can’t give us a straight answer, and crosses the verge of lying to the American people?! Because I sure am, and it’s time for a change. | But the biggest concern for me? Hayes stated, “My record matches what the people in this district have asked for.” Did our people ask for more taxes? Did they ask for soaring high inflation? Did they want to have to choose between putting food on the table or paying for gas to get to work? OF COURSE NOT!** These issues are hurting not only our state but our nation as a whole. Hayes will always be the reliable vote for Biden and Pelosi, We need all hands on deck to make a change - All my best, George S. Fellow American,

At 17 years old, I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. I got by _without_ government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

[ ](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=dbef83f0254e4983bcbb040dccc1aa5c&_e=hS_SVviBq0O9DLeaFX8du1WAuXzOR4_kBVExB-_DXEOJPsOBjFWwhSTbWlHh7xAKfQ1JH3Xd0zX4CX1OjSoSwT6J30yAikwuoC7ScRhAlF9r2_r_wEsZenF_dg0gdW4QvSAJCMWeutfQhTrOXNXTeNSRghGmAj0inkT7na2accP8XWd5CcZErj_OmAXkARC4uVPeud6vrU2Gkl4iflh5NXDrNfT8t1TA8Igh462s7qFoIb-52cNTM2dNVA6QFN0EaJfeLKo9NIqth4iAfsAYubNO5yBbxV_f-mCknwqGFZSIGfb-E9VXHChAEnw_yjBGMfGJDE1zAiVOWO9O4KGKawB5E9dVj3D50HT9M44YGhEsUD-1aDPgKtU00j1eslhpsGzCFA8Tpc_euouifc65z02pfg8atZDovv6DuGWy0pWbRYoP7uCJ4HUqrTFb5mdcsPO3H_vS9JSci44hhy1uLQ%3D%3D)

I went from Waffle House to Washington, with a few stops in between, but my first job taught me many lessons I use in Congress to this day: _the value of hard-work, kindness, and perseverance._

[**I’m running for re-election**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=dbef83f0254e4983bcbb040dccc1aa5c&_e=hS_SVviBq0O9DLeaFX8du1WAuXzOR4_kBVExB-_DXEOJPsOBjFWwhSTbWlHh7xAKfQ1JH3Xd0zX4CX1OjSoSwT6J30yAikwuoC7ScRhAlF9r2_r_wEsZenF_dg0gdW4QvSAJCMWeutfQhTrOXNXTeNSRghGmAj0inkT7na2accP8XWd5CcZErj_OmAXkARC4uVPeud6vrU2Gkl4iflh5NXDrNfT8t1TA8Igh462s7qFoIb-52cNTM2dNVA6QFN0E4dfl-j5wZrE7TxKqHyysVJxbPLFTeLEX3SF5_E_MeQ0vcSmGqwi2pMaXyfGATg7iZuqKbwRTI29x9_HpiZytrICEIXn4gIZYeyGz8Mnu3YTBRVxHuMNB8yDLwnH49r43l3kzmYYkFfuOcuKksK9MO0dj-rb_pJWIwomUSLJv5QcK7QdI_TeIgtgEUAn_W4ej6Fd3Au_xYRBLOY-dMszorA%3D%3D) because I understand the real problems American families are dealing with and how to find sustainable solutions. I didn’t grow up with millions in the bank, and a silver spoon in my mouth. My dad was an Army General and my mom a schoolteacher. My parents taught me the key to success, **work**.

And working is what I’ve been doing since I was 17.

Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices.

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal-elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=dbef83f0254e4983bcbb040dccc1aa5c&_e=hS_SVviBq0O9DLeaFX8du1WAuXzOR4_kBVExB-_DXEOJPsOBjFWwhSTbWlHh7xAKfQ1JH3Xd0zX4CX1OjSoSwT6J30yAikwuoC7ScRhAlF9r2_r_wEsZenF_dg0gdW4QvSAJCMWeutfQhTrOXNXTeNSRghGmAj0inkT7na2accP8XWd5CcZErj_OmAXkARC4uVPeud6vrU2Gkl4iflh5NXDrNfT8t1TA8Igh462s7qFoIb-52cNTM2dNVA6QFN0EQpUcrCQNGePTDR7Z0vavdcxVqgXgEkYoK7IBc_N1SnrFgQQwaNtmJHcf19S2kFbn75sVJXE9AxW1IepUZC1qf6wjsZrSzwew6Av-h-eXPxpyvzl65FfWx2wkSF6wuH25gNk6ghXvJeX5WW2RXco12Vvlmlqsc42HZfj-9lrIjGf9nPa0rtBe76Thk8ygQniiKd1kyGVNxnSV1I6Kzz_A0Q%3D%3D)

Alessandra made headlines when she challenged the status quo of New York and won to serve as State Senator. Alessandra already has a proven record of tackling some of the most important issues head on in her district, and we are sure that she is the right candidate to defeat the corporate friendly candidate in the race. body:
An announcement from John Wood | | |
---
| [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/08224909bd9c/we-did-it-john-wood-will-be-on-the-ballot-in-november-14168505?e=6306d47db1)
---
| | Dear Derek, I made the decision to run for the United States Senate when Eric Greitens was the favorite for the Republican nomination. That would have been unacceptable, embarrassing, and dangerous for my party, my state, and my Country. I believed Missouri voters deserved a truly principled, conservative choice this November and so did more than 22,000 Missourians who helped secure my position on the ballot.

Circumstances have changed. While I think I could have beaten Eric Greitens, Missouri no longer faces the risk of Greitens as our next U.S. Senator. While I have significant differences of opinion with both the Republican and Democratic nominees, it has become evident there is not a realistic path to victory for me as an independent candidate. Today, I will be announcing that I am ending my campaign for the United States Senate.

Many Missourians, as well as Americans across the country, have expressed their support for the noble causes of uniting our Country, defending democracy and protecting our Constitution. While my candidacy is ending, my commitment to these causes endures. I will continue to work in other ways to promote these efforts, which are dear to my heart.

I have been inspired in this campaign to follow the example set by great and courageous leaders such as Ronald Reagan, Jack Danforth, and Liz Cheney. I am hopeful that others who seek elected office will endeavor to set aside the extremist rhetoric that is dividing our Nation and begin the critical work of restoring public trust in our democratic institutions.

Lastly, I want to thank you and everyone else who has supported me in this effort. Thank you for placing your confidence in my campaign and for your willingness to join me in this effort to heal our country.

Please know that while my campaign for the US Senate is ending, my fight for our democracy is not. I will continue to stand up for our democratic republic and oppose those who prioritize party and self-interest over the needs of our country however I can.

Thank you again for your support.

John

name: Max Steiner
subject: Free School Lunches are a No-Brainer
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
guys like Doug LaMalfa love agricultural subsidies, but when it comes to lunch for our kids... | |
---
Friend, For the last two years, all school lunches have been free for K-12 students. The school lunch program, administered by the USDA, is good for students, families, and farmers. Students learn far better when they aren't hungry, free lunches help control costs for struggling families, and the programs support prices for farmers by purchasing U.S. food. During COVID, the eligibility requirements to receive free lunches was waived. All students received free meals. **Last spring, the Republicans in the Senate killed the Universal Free Lunch Program.** Going forward, families will again need to preemptively fill out paperwork to qualify for free or reduced-price lunches. Many families, accustomed to two years of free lunches, will not fill out the paperwork correctly, and will owe hundreds of dollars in school lunch bills by the end of the semester. The school lunch program serves almost 5 billion lunches a year and at a cost of 14 billion dollars. That's an excellent deal. Fraud is low: kids who don't need a free lunch generally have a higher-quality lunch packed by their (wealthier) parents. I mean, we've all seen school lunches - they aren't exactly luxury lunches. If a kid is hungry enough to eat a free school lunch, it's probably because he or she needs it. California -- run by Democrats -- has the right idea: it passed state legislation to provide and fund a universal free lunch program of its own. **The Republican Party votes against kids, against veterans, and against election results it dislikes. clean_body: guys like Doug LaMalfa love agricultural subsidies, but when it comes to lunch for our kids... | | Friend, For the last two years, all school lunches have been free for K-12 students. The school lunch program, administered by the USDA, is good for students, families, and farmers. Students learn far better when they aren't hungry, free lunches help control costs for struggling families, and the programs support prices for farmers by purchasing U.S. food. During COVID, the eligibility requirements to receive free lunches was waived. All students received free meals. Last spring, the Republicans in the Senate killed the Universal Free Lunch Program. Going forward, families will again need to preemptively fill out paperwork to qualify for free or reduced-price lunches. Many families, accustomed to two years of free lunches, will not fill out the paperwork correctly, and will owe hundreds of dollars in school lunch bills by the end of the semester. The school lunch program serves almost 5 billion lunches a year and at a cost of 14 billion dollars. That's an excellent deal. Fraud is low: kids who don't need a free lunch generally have a higher-quality lunch packed by their (wealthier) parents. I mean, we've all seen school lunches - they aren't exactly luxury lunches. If a kid is hungry enough to eat a free school lunch, it's probably because he or she needs it. California -- run by Democrats -- has the right idea: it passed state legislation to provide and fund a universal free lunch program of its own. The Republican Party votes against kids, against veterans, and against election results it dislikes. The only policy it supports is cutting taxes on their own donors - and paying themselves massive agricultural subsidies like Doug LaMalfa. We cannot let them retake the House. Can we be real with you for a moment?
We understand that a constant stream of emails asking for a contribution can sometimes get on your nerves. That’s okay. Real people wrote this email, we get them as well. We understand how people can get frustrated. _But let us explain why this is vital._
When we’re asking for your support, we don’t expect every person to give. But we ask because we know that when you can support the cause, you will. That’s how this transformative movement works.**It’s a whole lot of people doing their part to make something great.**
[Right now, we’re just eight days away from the end of the month, and we’re hoping to hit our August fundraising targets before then. The only way we can get there is through the support of small-dollar donors chipping in whatever they can. If you have the means, can you donate $3 right now? It’ll go a long way.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220823.QglF3j&refcode=em20220823-3323-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3323%2E2526796%2ELieezi)

We’re not exaggerating. Most members of Congress fuel their reelection campaigns by dedicating hours of their time asking rich donors for $500, $1000, or even $2900 donations.
**Alexandria is different.** This whole movement is fueled by online contributions like the ones we’re asking for in this email. With these contributions, we’ve built a campaign that is...
1. Raising resources, recruiting volunteers, and making calls to help elect progressive allies across Congress, and build a progressive majority.
2. Reaching out to communities across NY-14 to spread awareness about the Green New Deal, how to influence local, state, and federal leaders, how to access medical abortion by mail, and more.
3. Raising money for community relief organizations, closing critical resources gaps that the federal government has left unfilled.
4. Working day and night to reelect AOC, defeat our Republican opponents, and show the world what we can do.

[There are more than enough people reading this email that, if they just donated whatever they can spare, we’d be on track to hit our August fundraising targets. If this movement is the model of what you want in our politics, please donate today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220823.QglF3j&refcode=em20220823-3323-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3323%2E2526796%2ELieezi)
Thanks for reading,
Team AOC

First of all, I want to thank each and every one of my voters, supporters, volunteers, donors, and staff for being the best team a candidate could ask for! Thank you all!
We have had a fantastic year of campaigning that I wouldn't trade for the world, and I look forward to continuing in our fight for freedom with each and every one of you.
Many people have asked me what I am going to do from here, and I wanted to let you all know that I have accepted an offer to join the Johnson Team and will be working as the 2nd District Grassroots Director to re-elect Senator Johnson this November!
We don't have time to waste! Having Mandela Barnes as a Senator would be a near equivalent to having Mark Pocan in that seat, and that is something that our nation CAN NOT afford!
Please join me in helping re-elect Senator Johnson on November 8th. We need a strong coalition of volunteers to knock on doors, make phone calls, walk in parades, and more.
Join me in ensuring that we have conservative voices in Washington!
For God and Country, Charity Barry

body:

https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3e53719e73e3eaadecb93b455e9dd6dd0459da185cd53428e4008d1bea7caa425e5568e843615287094559d22d9c46ee7ab88a0bb730679ec12177d26e690b456900d3ff5bab0d7423a95c92e65aadf5

Peter,

Moments ago, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent –and Peter, it’s more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I’ve worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=61efc867f210eba0024eec8518bf0083b1c231a93960f182408fbcdb593fdaaee52038f68c44436b5c21da324b1bc76af28c73f68ccb9012fa5623853008a960
>>>">Stand with me to protect our state. >>>>

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that’s what this fight is all about.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=61efc867f210eba0024eec8518bf0083b1c231a93960f182408fbcdb593fdaaee52038f68c44436b5c21da324b1bc76af28c73f68ccb9012fa5623853008a960
>>>">Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free. >>>>

It’s not about me, it’s not about my opponent, it’s about you – your business, your children’s education, and your personal liberties.

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left’s radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers’ unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist – you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I’ve only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=61efc867f210eba0024eec8518bf0083b1c231a93960f182408fbcdb593fdaaee52038f68c44436b5c21da324b1bc76af28c73f68ccb9012fa5623853008a960
>>>">Rush in your support TODAY. >>>>

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business’ ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=61efc867f210eba0024eec8518bf0083b1c231a93960f182408fbcdb593fdaaee52038f68c44436b5c21da324b1bc76af28c73f68ccb9012fa5623853008a960
>>>">stand with me in the fight against the Left’s schemes and radical agenda. >>>>

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

| Friend,

We're just over one month into our general election campaign to keep the 49th blue, and _Fox News_ has officially weighed in. They’ve listed our district as a Toss-up headed into November.

Here’s an update on where the rest of the ratings stand: | **_CA-49 General Election Ratings_**
Cook Political Report: _Lean Democrat_
Sabato’s Crystal Ball: _Lean Democrat_
CalMatters: _Toss-up_
Real Clear Politics: _Toss-up_
Fox News: _Toss-up_

Normally, we take anything that comes out of this "news" network with a grain of salt, but these results are in-line with what we all know about this race: _It’s going to be close._

You can bet my opponent has already sent these ratings to each and every Trump-aligned megadonor in the country. His local support is thin, so the strategy is to convince outside spenders to dump MILLIONS in this race to replace me.

If there's one thing you should know about me, it's that I've never backed down from a tough fight. As a kid who grew up in public housing, I know what it's like to be counted out before you even get started. But through hard work and determination, I became the first in my family to graduate from college -- and then the senior pastor at Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s church. Now, I'm fighting in the Senate to ensure every child can achieve the American dream. But the only way I can fight back against GOP attacks and keep Georgia’s seat blue is with your help. We hope that, like us, you are enjoying the last month of summer — spending quality time with loved ones and taking some moments to disconnect from the craziness of the outside world to focus on your mental health and self-care.

You’ve probably noticed that we haven’t been as aggressive with our email program because as the season winds down, we know how valuable your time is. And we also know that efforts to raise money often fall short this time of year — we call it the “summer slump” in terms of fundraising.

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: “It’s like being the first colonizer on Jupiter...They’ve invented a new way. It’s a party that doesn’t have any thought. It’s all emotional, it’s all revenge. It’s all anger. That’s all it is."
body:
Subscribe on YouTube: The Takedown w/ Cliff Schecter
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **_"..I haven’t been hanged yet. But holy moly, this is just crazy. The place has lost its mind.”_** **This was[the shocking comment made by Rusty Bowers](https://default.salsalabs.org/T78d076c7-c693-42d3-9339-92d023a13256/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), Republican member of the Arizona House for 18 years, most recently as Speaker of the Arizona House. Bowers rejected Rudy Giuliani's indimidation tactics and Donald Trump's pleading to overthrow the will of the people and democracy in Arizona, to hand the election to Trump. ** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER FOR QUICK DAILY COVERAGE OF THE POLITICAL NEWS YOU NEED MOST!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1ff74199-2da9-417c-a9f3-ea0a793f8940/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [He even testified about it before the January 6th Committee](https://default.salsalabs.org/T81e201d9-2c19-4758-88f7-88b8a81f88bd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), refusing to take the coward's path that has so far defined Mike Pence--whom Trump told Mark Meadows deserved to be hanged that day. For Bowers, sharing the truth about the attempted coup with the Committee was it for him as a Republican, as the authoritarian cultists who run today's GOP weren't about to let that go unpunished. [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4654c94c-6cc1-4ff6-b010-8802f29e98bf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Just another case I cover in my series on Youtube, called["The Takedown w Cliff Schecter,](https://default.salsalabs.org/T20e5acb1-0be2-40e3-9c6a-de2b96111edd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)" to which [I humbly ask you to subscribe](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8f7912c1-3848-4234-bd22-2c814e207b73/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). At The Takedown, I tell one-minute "shorts" and longer three-eight minute stories geared towards sharing one simple truth with the viewer, a truth our mainstream media's too scared, greedy and/or careerist to tell:** **_It is not just Donald Trump, but the entire Republican Party that's become an autocratic entity rife w/ crony corruption, religious fanaticism, bigotry & cruelty. It's leaders seek, as a goal, to overthrow democratic govrernance. This is why [I ask you to subscribe to my channel](https://default.salsalabs.org/T04961146-c6a1-4662-8f29-f6f77e08562d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), so you can view these stories, share them with others and hopefully impact the upcoming election._** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1acaa13b-2928-4619-92ca-5e0aa01fbf68/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Bowers is like Reps. Liz Cheney & Pete Meijer, two of ten House Republicans who voted to impeach Donald Trump. All of them did their duty, upheld the oath they swore to the U.S. & Arizona Constitutions. Just that fact made it so they no longer had a place in today's Republican Party. **You don't have to like their politics--I think most of what they believe is awful. Yet, they refused to tear up our Constitution and overthrow our democracy, and just doing that ended their political careers in the GOP. Think about that for a second, what that says about that organization. [Bowers had more to say about](https://default.salsalabs.org/T462e493b-5ff4-464a-80ed-36d9fe642e77/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[ it himself](https://default.salsalabs.org/T348d6c38-15cc-41b5-9c1d-6d3e00ed9336/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9): _“The suite of candidates that we now have representing what used to be a principled party is just like, wow ... It’s like being the first colonizer on Jupiter_..._They’ve invented a new way. It’s a party that doesn’t have any thought. It’s all emotional, it’s all revenge. It’s all anger. That’s all it is. "_ [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47a65d59-d35a-489f-bee3-5fa2702f2b5f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This week I also talked about [Karl Rove's attacks on Trump, not because Rove cares about democracy, but because he fears it will lead to GOP losses in the midterms](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf8c73760-6fa0-4406-85a2-f219026f6c66/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), [as well as the guilty verdicts for the domestic terrorists--and members of the GOP base--who planned to kidnap Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te65a2c0e-8fc8-4695-98e8-d9e9415044e0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) to the Michigan and obtain, and set off, a weapon of mass destruction. [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te4b37bd8-90b9-476d-a5a8-2de498c3d1a8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We see this insanity every day now, with those who believe elections were stolen, Judaism is a curse, demons can transfer sexually transmitted diseases and drinking your own urine can cure COVID. The Trump-supported challenger to Bowers believe the election was "snatched by the devil himself." I'm pretty sure this is what Bowers meant when he said it's like being "the first colonizer on Jupiter." The Republican Party has been taken over by a group of characters who better fit a "Men In Black" sequel than an election in a democracy. But it's not cute or funny, it's downright terrifying. **This is why I started[The Takedown](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7c05c6a5-622a-4fbc-8a2a-3f3329b8e07e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) and one more time (I promise!) why I ask you [to please subscribe](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8c8da063-1564-41fa-b9a1-695944dc713c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). That platform is growing, as is this one. But we don't have FoxNews, Sinclair Media or Salem Radio. When a lifelong Republcian, who held one of the most prestigious positions in the party in Arizona,[ says of the political organization in which he has spent his entire life](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9560c14d-f0c1-4a77-9aeb-2a0f9d26bca8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9):** **__“The thought that if you don’t do what we like, then we will just get rid of you and march on and do it ourselves – that to me is fascism.”__** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1bbf2ee7-36d3-479d-944b-6d06603ea7a3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **People MUST know about it.** **The more people[who subscribe to the channel,](https://default.salsalabs.org/T11b62174-ae4c-47cd-abd6-f614d69d59c7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) the more Youtube promotes it, deciding it's worthy of seeing. That, and your sharing it with anyone you can [and encouraging them to subscribe](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td0cf8afc-a480-44d6-80ef-528edd61c19c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), is how we have a broader impact. ****We are in precarious times. We must rise to meet the challenge, as past generations have done. So I've decided, win or lose, I'm leaving it all out on the field. And I know you are much the same, or you wouldn't be here, and I am so thankful to you for that!** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te6f6a415-382c-495c-acb7-7d63dd13f329/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thanks for all you do, my friends, and please have a good evening. All my best, Cliff

clean_body: We can do better, Nebraska. | = | | Dear friends, As our kids head back to school, I know a lot of parents are concerned about our students’ safety this school year. As a mom, I hear you — even though my kids aren’t in school anymore, I am too. That’s why we have to hold legislators like my opponent accountable when they actively vote against measures to keep our schools and communities safe. | = Mike Flood voted against a bipartisan bill — supported by law enforcement — to establish an Amber Alert-like Network for Active Shootings. On his very first day in Washington, he voted against a bill to alert people about active shooters in their vicinity. In this epidemic of mass shootings, Mike Flood’s vote is outright dangerous. And Nebraska,we can do better. I’m running for Congress because I believe our students and our community need a leader who will fight for them every single day, even when it goes against their party leadership. We need a congresswoman who has the courage to stand up for what’s right, even when she may be standing alone. _****_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

subject: I was in North Carolina. It’s clear Cheri Beasley has what it takes to win, but she needs our support.

body:
I was just campaigning to elect Cheri Beasley as North Carolina’s next Senator.
#

I was just campaigning to elect Cheri Beasley as North Carolina’s next Senator and from everything I saw on the ground, it is very clear to me that we have a real shot to flip this seat.
The energy and enthusiasm for Cheri’s campaign are palpable. She’s running a true grassroots campaign. She’s reaching voters in every corner of the state — in rural and urban communities from the mountains to the coast.
Running a campaign like she is, in a state as big and competitive as North Carolina, is not easy. It takes a significant amount of resources to be able to turn out all of the voters necessary to win this race. Cheri needs all of us with her, so I am asking you myself:
[**Can you please make a donation of $3 or more to Cheri Beasley’s campaign in North Carolina today? There’s an important deadline at the end of this month, and every dollar will make a difference.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220823-2-MA&t=1&akid=1534%2E357359%2E8bV-LG)
It’s been a privilege to get to know Cheri. She’s a trailblazer and a real champion for justice and working people.
I know that she will be a voice for all North Carolinians. She’s not afraid to stand up to the corporate special interests in Washington, and she’ll fight for real progress on reproductive freedom, voting rights, lower prescription drug prices and so much more.
But the truth is that none of this would be possible without the support of people like you, [**so if you’re able, I hope you’ll make a donation to Cheri Beasley’s campaign today. This is a race we can — and must — win in November.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220823-2-MA&t=2&akid=1534%2E357359%2E8bV-LG)

name: =?utf-8?Q?Tara=20for=20Alaska?=
subject: Thanks for Your Support
body:
We ran a campaign focused on the issues, not partisan rhetoric. I’m proud of our team and what we accomplished together. | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | |
### Friends,

I decided to run for Congress because I wanted to fight for the people and communities I love. The last few months I’ve enjoyed traveling the state listening to Alaskans and hearing about the opportunities and challenges we face. It has only reinforced my passion to do whatever I can to make Alaska an even better place to call home.

That said, I have decided to end my campaign for Congress and will file the necessary paperwork to withdraw from the race. Looking at the outcome of the Regular Primary election, I don’t see a path to victory, nor to raise the resources needed to be successful this November.

I want to thank my dedicated volunteers and supporters for all they have done. We ran a campaign focused on the issues, not partisan rhetoric. I’m proud of our team and what we accomplished together.

This race is vitally important to Alaska’s future. We must ensure the best representation possible is in place as Alaska’s only voice in the House of Representatives. I look forward to working with a true Alaskan willing to carry forward the legacy of Don Young while serving in Congress. This state is worth fighting for and I am committed to making it a better place now and into the future.

With gratitude,

It's not completely unexpected, but we need to turn this around.
#
Our team has messaged you a few times about this, Peter, but I decided to reach out again today: Pramila's online fundraising is way behind pace from last month.
It’s not completely unexpected, because August is notoriously a tough time for grassroots fundraising — folks are on vacation, enjoying the outdoors, visiting family, and less focused on their inboxes.
It’s why we’re relying on you to chip in even more right now. Soon, we’ll be just weeks away from Election Day. The Democratic majorities and Pramila’s re-election will be on the line, and we have to pick up our fundraising starting today, Peter.
[**Can you make your first contribution to help us turn around our fundraising? With less eyes on our emails during a slow August, each one of your contributions means more.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16171?refcode=em20220823-1540&t=1&akid=1540%2E420207%2EceFXgj)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16171?refcode=em20220823-1540&t=20&akid=1540%2E420207%2EceFXgj)**

So, it’s significant that we saw a 19% decrease in online fundraising last quarter AND have seen a steep dip in email contributions this last month.
In 2022, our campaign has provided field organizing, phone banking, and fundraising support for people-first progressives running in primaries and Democrats running in tough swing district races against Republicans.
