Twitter and Facebook to Censor Speech in Leadup to Midterm Elections [=] Source: NewsBusters [=] Meta, the parent company of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, and Twitter pledged to target “misleading narratives” by suppressing election content they deem to be false, misleading, or dangerous. Censorship methods mentioned in the policies involved decreasing the reach of offending posts, the continued use of third-party fact-checkers, and updated content recommendation algorithms. [13x13x1] [=] READ MORE [=] Background Notes from Judicial Watch [180x150x1] [==] 2021-05-23 Records Show Iowa Officials Coordinated with Big Tech to Censor Election Posts [==] Source: Judicial Watch [==] Records from the Secretary of State of Iowa reveal how state officials pressured social media companies (Twitter and Facebook) to censor posts about the 2020 election. Included were emails from Iowa state officials to representatives of Big Tech pressuring these companies to remove Judicial Watch’s posts. The emails show how the state agency successfully pressured Facebook to censor Judicial Watch’s post about Iowa’s management of its voter rolls. [13x13x1] [==] READ MORE [==] [180x150x2] [=] 2021-02-23 Judicial Watch to Facebook: End Your Censorship of Trump [=] Source: Judicial Watch [=] “Facebook and Big Tech censorship of former President Trump is an attack on the free speech of every American,” stated Tom Fitton, Judicial Watch President. “Simply put: Big Tech must stop censoring conservatives in their effort to help Joe Biden.” [13x13x1] [=] READ MORE [=] [180x150x3] [=] 2021-07-01 Emails - Judicial Watch YouTube Video Censored at Request of California Government Officials [=] Source: Judicial Watch [=] Judicial Watch announced that it received 165 pages of new documents from the office of the Secretary of State of California showing the office directly emailing Google employees to remove a Judicial Watch video on election integrity. body:
RE-ELECT LIZZIE PANNILL FLETCHER U.S. CONGRESS [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo.jpg]
Last week, Lizzie and our campaign met with precinct chairs in Fort Bend County, which is all new territory for #TeamLizzie. Together, we discussed how best to organize and mobilize ahead of Election Day.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220823wu?refcode=lpfe220823wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220823wu?refcode=lpfe220823wu_m]
This week marks 102 years since the 19th Amendment was adopted into law, giving women the right to vote. That year, over 8 million women voted for the first time.
Today, women’s rights, voting rights, civil rights, and equal rights are in danger. From the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade to the hundreds of voting restrictions that have been introduced across the country, the threats are real and they’re happening in plain sight.
We can honor the legacy of the suffragists who fought for our most fundamental rights by promoting a fair and inclusive democracy. By fighting for our right to privacy, autonomy, and dignity. And by making our voices heard at the ballot box this November.
The opportunity to make our voices heard in this year’s elections is coming up fast, too. As of tomorrow, we’ll be two months out from the start of early voting in Texas!
Make sure you and all the Texans you know are registered to vote here. The deadline for registering is October 11. [https://www.votetexas.gov/register-to-vote/index.html]
The window to talk to voters before they start casting their ballots is shrinking. Want to help? Attend one of our weekly postcard parties!
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/486971/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/486971/]
We’re writing postcards to our neighbors in TX-07 to get out the vote. Our next party is this Thursday, August 25. You can RSVP to attend here. You can RSVP to attend here. [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/486971/]
Last month, Lizzie’s bill protecting the right to travel out of state for abortion care passed the House, and she’s not stopping there. She’s continuing to lead efforts to protect access to reproductive care for Texans and people across the country.
Newsweek:
“Democrats Propose Travel Grants for Those Seeking Out-of-State Abortions”
July 21, 2022
Lizzie introduced a bill that, if passed, would help ease financial burdens placed on people who travel long distances for abortion care in a post- Roe world. That’s especially crucial for the thousands of people in Texas and other states who are traveling out of state each month for reproductive care — Texans are traveling an average of 542 miles to get the care they need.
It’s so important we know where our elected leaders stand on issues like reproductive rights, so come November, we vote for people we know will fight for the issues that matter to us, treat them with the urgency they demand, and stand up for our freedoms.
Thanks for being part of the team,
Team Lizzie

| | **This Week on the Campaign Trail** Things are heating up on the trail as summer begins to wind down! We are working hard to meet every voter in the tenth district and earn their support, but we need your help! Every effort is appreciated, whether it be volunteering your time, contributing, or placing a yard sign in your lawn. The stakes of this election are too high to sit on the sidelines.
---
**Afghanistan Withdrawal** Last week marked one year since Joe Biden’s botched withdrawal from Afghanistan began. As a twenty-five-year veteran of Navy Special Operations, this unfortunate anniversary is especially on my mind this week. My last deployment to Afghanistan ended in January of 2021. Six months later, I watched Kabul fall, eerily similar to what my family experienced during the fall of Saigon. Let us not forget the thirteenth servicemen and women who lost their lives this month, one year ago. And let us not forget the fourteenth serviceman who would later die following the completion of the withdrawal.
---
---
**RNC Veterans Outreach Center** Last week, I joined Congressman Rob Whitman, Attorney General Jason Miyras, and others for the grand opening of Virginia’s first Republican Veterans Community Center in Virginia Beach. As a veteran, I’m committed to serving the tenth district’s veterans and being their strongest advocate in Congress. Our district is home to many former military, law enforcement, and intelligence community members, and they deserve a Representative in Washington who will actually listen to their concerns and address their often-overlooked challenges.
---
---
**Winsome Endorsement** Last week, I was thrilled to accept the support of Virginia’s Lt. Governor, Winsome Earle-Sears! Winsome and I are one of the many diverse faces of the Republican party here in Virginia. As they did in 2021, Virginians are ready to elect leaders that share their values and we are both working hard to share those values with all residents of the Commonwealth. Let's get the government to work with us, not above us!
---
---
**The Truth with Lisa Boothe** Last Thursday, I was a guest on The Truth with Lisa Boothe. I shared my family's story of fleeing communism and discussed my professional career. Lisa and I also spent time talking about the implications of the Afghanistan withdrawal and where we are as a country and a military now. Be sure to listen to the great conservation: [The Truth with Lisa Boothe: From the Military to Congress with Hung Cao](http://links.hungforcongress.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=38f03aa6014c41e79b3e47e4aeaf6c86&_e=onBaAwH1PuRyew2lE-oksnsF45phuzAYGZ8yzWpTqOQvHzo5vVgueyxfrN_3QKKwep-hb8IgRBwVh6PMMu5SlZX2pqMeBmXE329M9OWF-_oWEmnrP-dXrM5FPUZWqEuFMdtCle_oxQmPSer5OnSIrRoThEDrfDsM8Y1d09YUX4yJHZd0nKOt1vBxqL0VGu7YM-TIpkV0piF99msy4XX0aZPBluoVS5LWJzZoNKSazSnqM7XXdkQVZthusHz6DweR2mZ7HO6bodsk-npDxHVdz3r8bCJqOZfS5fKhouoaL69fnmH98othfnZEFqC8J2QuTqz0sCg_awBXoAzYxNfN-9IWbaX2MnJbZosygQVN8_o3XngB3SdhyQS5G-5M1GpsjHMZAgYRhmSTp1CInWmFvjj_dFx28GZnUCUxUE2TazlHGOaj6qGToIZq3G9uD8uyG6g_7oO5J6hEHNDRcGr8Lj8m9kCyV8XoPxt5Fb8Y9jc%3D)

clean_body: | | | | | August 23rd 2022 | WEEKLY NEWSLETTER | Issue 7 | | This Week on the Campaign Trail Things are heating up on the trail as summer begins to wind down! We are working hard to meet every voter in the tenth district and earn their support, but we need your help! Every effort is appreciated, whether it be volunteering your time, contributing, or placing a yard sign in your lawn. The stakes of this election are too high to sit on the sidelines. Afghanistan Withdrawal Last week marked one year since Joe Biden’s botched withdrawal from Afghanistan began. As a twenty-five-year veteran of Navy Special Operations, this unfortunate anniversary is especially on my mind this week. My last deployment to Afghanistan ended in January of 2021. Six months later, I watched Kabul fall, eerily similar to what my family experienced during the fall of Saigon. Let us not forget the thirteenth servicemen and women who lost their lives this month, one year ago. And let us not forget the fourteenth serviceman who would later die following the completion of the withdrawal. RNC Veterans Outreach Center Last week, I joined Congressman Rob Whitman, Attorney General Jason Miyras, and others for the grand opening of Virginia’s first Republican Veterans Community Center in Virginia Beach. As a veteran, I’m committed to serving the tenth district’s veterans and being their strongest advocate in Congress. Our district is home to many former military, law enforcement, and intelligence community members, and they deserve a Representative in Washington who will actually listen to their concerns and address their often-overlooked challenges. Winsome Endorsement Last week, I was thrilled to accept the support of Virginia’s Lt. Governor, Winsome Earle-Sears! Winsome and I are one of the many diverse faces of the Republican party here in Virginia. As they did in 2021, Virginians are ready to elect leaders that share their values and we are both working hard to share those values with all residents of the Commonwealth. Let's get the government to work with us, not above us! The Truth with Lisa Boothe Last Thursday, I was a guest on The Truth with Lisa Boothe. I shared my family's story of fleeing communism and discussed my professional career. Lisa and I also spent time talking about the implications of the Afghanistan withdrawal and where we are as a country and a military now. Be sure to listen to the great conservation: | Store We will not be placing a large order of hats or shirts until closer to the election. Until then, | Social Media to Share Here are a few of our top posts from social media this week. ---
Good Afternoon, Peter, Xin lỗi is how you would apologize or say sorry for something in Vietnamese.

I mention this because, at one point for me, even simple words like this were hard to re-learn in a new language, **especially as a 4-year-old Vietnamese refugee who had just escaped communism after my father was put on a North Vietnamese kill list.**
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e58ea6356e434fa2b55936078c47e5e0&_e=KtA0HKcSIbjmB07pGkfq3P3XWvZy_79OOxxVGLdlRjt_8ZWxK9V2dg836kYyYokVC_iBDIyPQGWGTi179uLkfj-ygGqhsKI2PhWHiZ2JDe25u0azvABwVHkLv1oVg7dHLFHaQg-pomAjYZ9jN_LBV6mww5hOC6hTqC-K9WFa_98PS-9WU2saofItF4lX1dC51s0GUdkTMDWMkRx9pQazQVvJOWHA0p81Fb1OU3z9K3GxPIpelfB_RsU48UkygoNQf00NLI4A20x292tlAKZ7UycjPRnEWQpxi8Z5VhR-zb_H0PBuzOGuxF4wSXS8sKK91ugO0Fv4q8srYCEbqaCvrV6GCfHtyDUB2pWDPqDqmMqwTZrR_3rN4pyQ314yJ9Jeck4lgQLfHyHKmuspmMj6bg%3D%3D)
---
Despite those hardships, I broke my back to learn English, to become an American Citizen, and then graduate from the United States Naval Academy to become an American Naval Officer.

**My life story is what the American Dream is all about, Peter, and that’s exactly why Pelosi and her fake “party of diversity” are attacking me -_because I don’t fit their stereotypes_. _But I’m NOT sorry for this!_** Pelosi is threatened by me because I have a real shot at flipping Virginia’s 10th Congressional District and giving Republicans control of the House.**** [**Help me show Pelosi that she has good reason to be afraid of a having a conservative Republican, anti-communist, Vietnamese American, retired Naval Officer in Congress.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e58ea6356e434fa2b55936078c47e5e0&_e=KtA0HKcSIbjmB07pGkfq3P3XWvZy_79OOxxVGLdlRjt_8ZWxK9V2dg836kYyYokVC_iBDIyPQGWGTi179uLkfj-ygGqhsKI2PhWHiZ2JDe25u0azvABwVHkLv1oVg7dHLFHaQg-pomAjYZ9jN_LBV6mww5hOC6hTqC-K9WFa_98PS-9WU2saofItF4lX1dC56jKLi-5U8rVB2_nVUY_JS3c2DWTzQXJa9Iw-XuYqIPfOHoTryg0BN0NCp5s2s5bCkiNIrf4rG7hfGv6ZBBrTRpdy-ZkSUhd2JHYyz4vuyvm-TKKLAGyxgZxb8-uXnGCxXzXsZw5k9oIL7DjNQfrsqdfiAy0SBP_5YdGj_G8Dm8yjJtsOWzsv9d_lpmFxzVGRSYiPJJrufM-eCPgVjGFCtg%3D%3D)
---
[**STAND WITH HUNG CAO >> DEFEAT PELOSI**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e58ea6356e434fa2b55936078c47e5e0&_e=KtA0HKcSIbjmB07pGkfq3P3XWvZy_79OOxxVGLdlRjt_8ZWxK9V2dg836kYyYokVC_iBDIyPQGWGTi179uLkfj-ygGqhsKI2PhWHiZ2JDe25u0azvABwVHkLv1oVg7dHLFHaQg-pomAjYZ9jN_LBV6mww5hOC6hTqC-K9WFa_98PS-9WU2saofItF4lX1dC5dtjdItQvmXlDZmMJ2RRb7ugTwc6vq09VfvrXaqqVkJyH7uqxTtm3GcQL1oPblxT5i8IAz-AE6MiQIlffdlM-tmsHUojHQjg65hvSmEBBQvfZvwlKA116BUOWiic-7kJ2M04LuObkr3akhqDgq0JpYG3_1hcnfI1bVpaeOoAF4vLv75ppQeYMp2UKSuy-LOHAUfiU7U5GePeGVv5dFuuKyw%3D%3D)
---
Pelosi thinks every refugee, immigrant, or a person of color has to vote with Washington Democrats on every issue, **_no matter what_.

As an Asian American Refugee, I’m telling you _she’s wrong_ , and that’s why I’m the Republican Nominee for Congress in Virginia’s 10th District.** [**Peter, if you’re as sick and tired of Pelosi politics and left-wing stereotypes as I am, then stand with me to restore our Nation so we can show them how Republican values are for all Americans.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e58ea6356e434fa2b55936078c47e5e0&_e=KtA0HKcSIbjmB07pGkfq3P3XWvZy_79OOxxVGLdlRjt_8ZWxK9V2dg836kYyYokVC_iBDIyPQGWGTi179uLkfj-ygGqhsKI2PhWHiZ2JDe25u0azvABwVHkLv1oVg7dHLFHaQg-pomAjYZ9jN_LBV6mww5hOC6hTqC-K9WFa_98PS-9WU2saofItF4lX1dC5xMbY_uW9IdOUucxjGcRzbquEZ-NRXorx0ehdhJephR7ELdPjewvpMbXvtHF3fXGMPWzouN-4btvfHOYwXoXeL2RjO6OYC5gn0HlKnKAK-hA715lP-N1pmByf4up3WsmIZG_KArOclk8ODz6HXDkmrxKK6ROcZGedh6M0sMKV_b5I_ubVX6DQXum1WbLzwAsGtVk3V1G3Xlt6y1F7kaiwSw%3D%3D) Answer this call to duty with me and let’s get America back on track.
---
Thank you and God bless,

| | | | | Peter, **This anti-Semite casually insulted everyone who lost a loved one in the Holocaust, and I'm so sick of it.** **_Scott Jensen, the particular idiot the GOP nominated for Governor of Minnesota, yet again pulled the crap Republicans repeat like a tic--he compared live-saving, COVID-prevention measures to the Holocaust._** **It makes my blood boil.** **I’m too young to have known them, but my family lost numerous members to Adolf Hitler's genocidal regime,** and I can't tell you how much it enrages me when historically ignorant, casually stupid and completely cynical jackasses like Scott Jensen make this comparison. It is sick, really. [**This is about policy and culture. But I must also admit, for me, it's also personal. Will you please join me in sending a message that people like Jensen are UNACCEPTABLE in public service--anywhere, at any time--and consider giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to ensure Democratic Governor Tim Walz is reelected, and Scott Jensen ends up in the ash heap of history where he belongs?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfe1bf339-785b-40cf-80fb-8b4b6527c9d7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _The list is of obtuse, power-lusting Republicans who've done this is too long to name, but you know the most infamous ones: Marjorie Taylor Greene, Lauren Boebert, Madison Cawthorn and Scott Perry, all seditionists who helped Trump plan and cover up a bloody coup attempt on January 6th, and in Perry's case, an individual who has already had his phone confiscated as evidence by the FBI after the Mar-a-Lago raid._ **It’s no coincidence that those who casually, almost gleefully mention the Holocaust, are the very same ghouls who are trying to bring fascism to America, via armed rebellion if necessary.** Back to Jensen. As you can probably guess, _he also believes the 2020 election should have been overturned and his LT. Governor candiate on his ticket made abhorrent comment that "women always want to go to the rape card," mocking women wishing to terminate a pregnancy brought on by the ultimate act of violence against them. Jensen would ban all abortion except when *they* determine a woman's life is in danger. _ When you dig further into his record, his sociopathy becomes more and more apparent. _Jensen said he'd commute the sentence of former police officer Kim Potter, found guilty of executing African-American motorist Daunte Wright at a traffic stop in 2020._** This is a sick, deeply-racist individual who should be getting evaluated, not nominated to run for governor. But, ya know, today's Republican Party.**

Peter,

At 17 years old, I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. I got by _without_ government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d65ecbf919144732b590502b415e0955&_e=okFrc6Zvm3suRAOuLLsm7GBsh-kRUSsQvxINYg_EZ6dCzx5aLWfncYfYP8YjdAPjabEBEB0v2KPYLUqL0pqHkWwIXYnkBc3jTDRSG-JtbUmsL67hixyUdB8CpKcD3ybBEUFGTkoLROeWGCUpkIBFPNgm4z4WK6fnwwkkc6zn_n8m1PbvlxJ9GldzRD9NZ2vKGcjqahqq3hySHsn-ZSAri6UciKf9lkzaEwkYbSnukJuku33MuY5w7YPrcig5CAyzxAygS-x6pKUtnI7VN7e_50Dd_onAHihQjmyK5eAqOL9LkifnKmcFG4xKsq0A6pc7192ggA7Iz6mmbHch0DmQotkSQ9s0zG_P_P4-x9F3wAJ7mOQPTsiSsIDkx0PQRHf9DrXu3dYW3f6Zy-FRFHRFz9R7ALNFnpSWLq6puDFKBvRLeVKp5-FxM70UlTRWof8dACwPuEFktG6-rk647qJvBA%3D%3D)

I went from Waffle House to Washington, with a few stops in between, but my first job taught me many lessons I use in Congress to this day: _the value of hard-work, kindness, and perseverance._

[**I’m running for re-election**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d65ecbf919144732b590502b415e0955&_e=okFrc6Zvm3suRAOuLLsm7GBsh-kRUSsQvxINYg_EZ6dCzx5aLWfncYfYP8YjdAPjabEBEB0v2KPYLUqL0pqHkWwIXYnkBc3jTDRSG-JtbUmsL67hixyUdB8CpKcD3ybBEUFGTkoLROeWGCUpkIBFPNgm4z4WK6fnwwkkc6zn_n8m1PbvlxJ9GldzRD9NZ2vKGcjqahqq3hySHsn-ZSAri6UciKf9lkzaEwkYbSnukJuku33MuY5w7YPrcig5CAyzH3dknydHjSnxbDAd4Zwv8t-q_LVBCJ9UVHK__zVleN-NyVPlNhdopx1qnSygvq-gF1sFcJNgMuF3NwK0wUyo2yTu_H1wIuiDH9lpn35WfEsjOp9LMfih83IpQwJzqyq84kbN1BNQTcyL07GdIh2B67z4lrIcXLk4MrozEz7kJjAs9PBwzbBqurh7CFDPOxCItsTZs0Ai7MMUQ0rDNL5iaw%3D%3D) because I understand the real problems American families are dealing with and how to find sustainable solutions. I didn’t grow up with millions in the bank, and a silver spoon in my mouth. My dad was an Army General and my mom a schoolteacher. My parents taught me the key to success, **work**.

And working is what I’ve been doing since I was 17.

Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices.

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal-elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d65ecbf919144732b590502b415e0955&_e=okFrc6Zvm3suRAOuLLsm7GBsh-kRUSsQvxINYg_EZ6dCzx5aLWfncYfYP8YjdAPjabEBEB0v2KPYLUqL0pqHkWwIXYnkBc3jTDRSG-JtbUmsL67hixyUdB8CpKcD3ybBEUFGTkoLROeWGCUpkIBFPNgm4z4WK6fnwwkkc6zn_n8m1PbvlxJ9GldzRD9NZ2vKGcjqahqq3hySHsn-ZSAri6UciKf9lkzaEwkYbSnukJuku33MuY5w7YPrcig5CAyzCsmtqJsHNVAlhGJJQKPAorLIYg8db1wTc21x-tWGnNP4y875SSDATJNKdqibkl0nAIQNkYisHPvRUHJhnyDnETVbxVXg06xRNFFsxuNylS_BnXGBiVuRQQL4Bj1Ber420lDAzxsOHNL759r1eux81I93csr-riXARGQSJzVeyIw1l93sq3TV74DOmbEKphXLCGpbx6w8LukZT4w0eTVOzg%3D%3D)

Fellow American,

This past week, it was my opponent Jahana Hayes’ turn to be interviewed on the _Real Story_ , and it left me with many questions and great concern. **Here’s why:**

_
* When Hayes first ran in 2018, **she pledged never to take any corporate money** - but since she’s been in office, she has taken **at least $100,000** from some of our nation’s largest corporations.

* She hesitated and redirected her response on whether she would support Biden in 2024, but by the end of it, **Hayes stated that she would vote for Biden, despite his plummeting approval rating.**

* When asked about Hayes paying her children with campaign finances, all she said was that it wasn’t illegal. **She couldn’t even state what role they play in her campaign!**
